        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=180000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def align_scores(model, x):
    scores = model.decision_function(x)
    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]
    return out


def align_logprobs(model, x):
    scores = model.predict_log_proba(x)
    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]
    return out


def build_char_vocab(texts, max_vocab=160):
    counts = {}
    for text in texts:
        for ch in text:
            counts[ch] = counts.get(ch, 0) + 1

    ordered = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda z: (-z[1], z[0]))
    vocab = {"<PAD>": 0, "<UNK>": 1}
    for ch, _ in ordered[: max_vocab - 2]:
        vocab[ch] = len(vocab)
    return vocab


def encode_texts(texts, vocab, max_len=500):
    out = np.zeros((len(texts), max_len), dtype=np.int64)
    unk = vocab["<UNK>"]

    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        ids = [vocab.get(ch, unk) for ch in text[:max_len]]
        if ids:
            out[i, : len(ids)] = ids
    return out


class CharacterCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, emb_dim=64, channels=96):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(
            vocab_size,
            emb_dim,
            padding_idx=0,
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Conv1d(emb_dim, channels, kernel_size=k) for k in (3, 5, 7)]
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.35)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(channels * 3, N_CLASSES)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.embedding(x).transpose(1, 2)
        pooled = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            z = torch.relu(conv(x))
            z = torch.max(z, dim=2).values
            pooled.append(z)
        z = torch.cat(pooled, dim=1)
        return self.fc(self.dropout(z))


def fit_cnn(x_train, y_train, vocab_size, epochs=5):
    model = CharacterCNN(vocab_size).to(DEVICE)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        model.parameters(),
        lr=2e-3,
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(x_train),
        torch.from_numpy(y_train.astype(np.int64)),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(
        dataset,
        batch_size=256,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=0,
        pin_memory=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"),
    )

    model.train()
    for _ in range(epochs):
        for xb, yb in loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)

            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            loss = criterion(model(xb), yb)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

    return model


@torch.no_grad()
def cnn_logits(model, x):
    model.eval()
    dataset = TensorDataset(torch.from_numpy(x))
    loader = DataLoader(
        dataset,
        batch_size=512,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=0,
        pin_memory=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"),
    )

    outputs = []
    for (xb,) in loader:
        xb = xb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
        outputs.append(model(xb).detach().cpu().numpy())

    return np.vstack(outputs).astype(np.float64)


def fit_sparse_models(x_word, x_char, x_wb, x_count, train_idx, valid_idx, y):
    svc_params = dict(
        C=2.5,
        max_iter=5000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    word_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params)
    char_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params)
    wb_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params)
    nb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    word_model.fit(x_word[train_idx], y[train_idx])
    char_model.fit(x_char[train_idx], y[train_idx])
    wb_model.fit(x_wb[train_idx], y[train_idx])
    nb_model.fit(x_count[train_idx], y[train_idx])

    valid_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            align_scores(word_model, x_word[valid_idx]),
            align_scores(char_model, x_char[valid_idx]),
            align_scores(wb_model, x_wb[valid_idx]),
            align_logprobs(nb_model, x_count[valid_idx]),
        ]
    )
    return valid_meta


def fit_final_sparse_models(x_word, x_char, x_wb, x_count, y):
    svc_params = dict(
        C=2.5,
        max_iter=5000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    word_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params).fit(x_word, y)
    char_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params).fit(x_char, y)
    wb_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params).fit(x_wb, y)
    nb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08).fit(x_count, y)

    return word_model, char_model, wb_model, nb_model


def main():
    seed_everything()

    train = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv"))
    test = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv"))

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes.astype(np.int64)

    # Fit unsupervised representations once on train plus test.
    word_vec = make_word_tfidf()
    char_vec = make_char_tfidf()
    wb_vec = make_char_wb_tfidf()
    count_vec = make_word_counts()

    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    wb_all = wb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    count_all = count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    n_train = len(train)
    x_word = word_all[:n_train]
    x_char = char_all[:n_train]
    x_wb = wb_all[:n_train]
    x_count = count_all[:n_train]

    x_word_test = word_all[n_train:]
    x_char_test = char_all[n_train:]
    x_wb_test = wb_all[n_train:]
    x_count_test = count_all[n_train:]

    # Character neural representation.
    char_vocab = build_char_vocab(all_text, max_vocab=160)
    encoded_all = encode_texts(all_text, char_vocab, max_len=500)
    encoded_train = encoded_all[:n_train]
    encoded_test = encoded_all[n_train:]

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # Four sparse models produce 12 meta-features; CNN adds 3.
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 15), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(train_text, y), 1):
        print(f"fold {fold}/5")

        sparse_valid = fit_sparse_models(
            x_word,
            x_char,
            x_wb,
            x_count,
            tr_idx,
            va_idx,
            y,
        )

        cnn = fit_cnn(
            encoded_train[tr_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
            vocab_size=len(char_vocab),
            epochs=5,
        )
        cnn_valid = cnn_logits(cnn, encoded_train[va_idx])

        oof_meta[va_idx] = np.hstack([sparse_valid, cnn_valid])

        del cnn
        if DEVICE.type == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    best_loss = np.inf
    best_c = None

    for c_value in [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]:
        stacker = LogisticRegression(
            C=c_value,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=2000,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)
        pred = stacker.predict_proba(oof_scaled)
        score = log_loss(y, pred, labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES))

        if score < best_loss:
            best_loss = score
            best_c = c_value

    print(f"5-fold OOF log loss: {best_loss:.6f}")
    print(f"selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=2000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    word_model, char_model, wb_model, nb_model = fit_final_sparse_models(
        x_word,
        x_char,
        x_wb,
        x_count,
        y,
    )

    final_sparse_test = np.hstack(
        [
            align_scores(word_model, x_word_test),
            align_scores(char_model, x_char_test),
            align_scores(wb_model, x_wb_test),
            align_logprobs(nb_model, x_count_test),
        ]
    )

    final_cnn = fit_cnn(
        encoded_train,
        y,
        vocab_size=len(char_vocab),
        epochs=6,
    )
    final_cnn_test = cnn_logits(final_cnn, encoded_test)

    test_meta = np.hstack([final_sparse_test, final_cnn_test])
    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(scaler.transform(test_meta))
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def make_word_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=1,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=190000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_wb_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=190000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_word_counts():
    return CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=190000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_svc():
    return LinearSVC(
        C=2.5,
        max_iter=6000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )


def aligned_svc_scores(model, x):
    """
    Return decision scores in fixed columns [class 0, class 1, class 2].
    LinearSVC's binary decision_function has one score whose positive
    direction corresponds to model.classes_[1].
    """
    scores = model.decision_function(x)
    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        if len(model.classes_) != 2:
            raise ValueError(
                "Unexpected one-dimensional SVC output for "
                f"{len(model.classes_)} classes."
            )

        negative_class = int(model.classes_[0])
        positive_class = int(model.classes_[1])
        out[:, negative_class] = -scores
        out[:, positive_class] = scores
    else:
        for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
            out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    return out


def aligned_nb_logprobs(model, x):
    scores = model.predict_log_proba(x)
    out = np.full(
        (x.shape[0], N_CLASSES),
        -np.inf,
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    return out


def fit_fold_models(
    y_train,
    train_idx,
    valid_idx,
    word_all,
    char_all,
    wb_all,
    count_all,
):
    word_model = make_svc()
    char_model = make_svc()
    wb_model = make_svc()
    nb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    word_model.fit(word_all[train_idx], y_train[train_idx])
    char_model.fit(char_all[train_idx], y_train[train_idx])
    wb_model.fit(wb_all[train_idx], y_train[train_idx])
    nb_model.fit(count_all[train_idx], y_train[train_idx])

    valid_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            aligned_svc_scores(word_model, word_all[valid_idx]),
            aligned_svc_scores(char_model, char_all[valid_idx]),
            aligned_svc_scores(wb_model, wb_all[valid_idx]),
            aligned_nb_logprobs(nb_model, count_all[valid_idx]),
        ]
    )

    return (
        word_model,
        char_model,
        wb_model,
        nb_model,
        valid_meta,
    )


def predict_fold_models(
    models,
    word_test,
    char_test,
    wb_test,
    count_test,
):
    word_model, char_model, wb_model, nb_model = models

    return np.hstack(
        [
            aligned_svc_scores(word_model, word_test),
            aligned_svc_scores(char_model, char_test),
            aligned_svc_scores(wb_model, wb_test),
            aligned_nb_logprobs(nb_model, count_test),
        ]
    )


def main():
    train_path = f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv"
    test_path = f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv"

    train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test = pd.read_csv(test_path)

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes.astype(np.int64)

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected class label found in train.csv.")

    n_train = len(train)
    n_test = len(test)

    print(f"Training rows: {n_train}")
    print(f"Test rows: {n_test}")
    print("Class counts:", dict(zip(CLASSES, np.bincount(y, minlength=N_CLASSES))))

    # Fit unsupervised vocabularies on train + test for consistent features.
    print("Fitting word TF-IDF vocabulary...")
    word_vec = make_word_tfidf()
    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    print(f"Word TF-IDF shape: {word_all.shape}")

    print("Fitting character TF-IDF vocabulary...")
    char_vec = make_char_tfidf()
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    print(f"Character TF-IDF shape: {char_all.shape}")

    print("Fitting boundary-aware character TF-IDF vocabulary...")
    wb_vec = make_char_wb_tfidf()
    wb_all = wb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    print(f"Character-WB TF-IDF shape: {wb_all.shape}")

    print("Fitting binary word-count vocabulary...")
    count_vec = make_word_counts()
    count_all = count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    print(f"Binary word-count shape: {count_all.shape}")

    word_train = word_all[:n_train]
    char_train = char_all[:n_train]
    wb_train = wb_all[:n_train]
    count_train = count_all[:n_train]

    word_test = word_all[n_train:]
    char_test = char_all[n_train:]
    wb_test = wb_all[n_train:]
    count_test = count_all[n_train:]

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    n_meta_features = 4 * N_CLASSES
    oof_meta = np.zeros(
        (n_train, n_meta_features),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    fold_models = []

    for fold, (train_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(
        cv.split(train_text, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        print(f"Training fold {fold}/5")

        models = fit_fold_models(
            y_train=y,
            train_idx=train_idx,
            valid_idx=valid_idx,
            word_all=word_train,
            char_all=char_train,
            wb_all=wb_train,
            count_all=count_train,
        )

        fold_models.append(models[:4])
        oof_meta[valid_idx] = models[4]

    # Standardize heterogeneous model scores before stacking.
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    best_loss = np.inf
    best_c = None

    for c_value in [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]:
        stacker_candidate = LogisticRegression(
            C=c_value,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=3000,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        stacker_candidate.fit(oof_scaled, y)
        oof_pred = stacker_candidate.predict_proba(oof_scaled)

        score = log_loss(
            y,
            np.clip(oof_pred, 1e-15, 1.0),
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

        if score < best_loss:
            best_loss = score
            best_c = c_value

    print(f"5-fold OOF log loss: {best_loss:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    # Fit the final stacker using all OOF meta-features.
    stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=3000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    # Average test meta-features from all independently trained folds.
    test_meta_sum = np.zeros(
        (n_test, n_meta_features),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    for fold, models in enumerate(fold_models, start=1):
        print(f"Predicting test set with fold {fold}/5")
        test_meta_sum += predict_fold_models(
            models=models,
            word_test=word_test,
            char_test=char_test,
            wb_test=wb_test,
            count_test=count_test,
        )

    test_meta = test_meta_sum / len(fold_models)
    test_scaled = scaler.transform(test_meta)
    test_pred = stacker.predict_proba(test_scaled)

    # Ensure valid finite probabilities and exact row normalization.
    test_pred = np.nan_to_num(
        test_pred,
        nan=1.0 / N_CLASSES,
        posinf=1.0 / N_CLASSES,
        neginf=1.0 / N_CLASSES,
    )
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        test_pred,
        columns=CLASSES,
    )
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Saved ./submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.")
    print("Submission columns:", list(submission.columns))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    scores = model.predict_log_proba(x)
    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]
    return out


def bm25_transform(x, train_rows, k1=1.2, b=0.75):
    """
    BM25 weighting using the supplied training rows to estimate IDF.
    The input matrix uses raw word n-gram counts.
    """
    x = x.tocsr().astype(np.float32, copy=True)
    n_docs = train_rows.shape[0]

    train_x = x[train_rows]
    df = np.asarray((train_x > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)

    idf = np.log(1.0 + (n_docs - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5)).astype(np.float32)

    lengths = np.asarray(x.sum(axis=1)).ravel().astype(np.float32)
    avg_len = float(lengths[train_rows].mean())
    if avg_len <= 0:
        avg_len = 1.0

    norm = k1 * (1.0 - b + b * lengths / avg_len)

    indptr = x.indptr
    row_ids = np.repeat(
        np.arange(x.shape[0], dtype=np.int32),
        np.diff(indptr),
    )

    data = x.data
    data *= k1 + 1.0
    data /= data + norm[row_ids]
    data *= idf[x.indices]

    return x


def fit_views(all_text):
    word_vec = make_word_tfidf()
    char_vec = make_char_tfidf()
    wb_vec = make_char_wb_tfidf()
    count_vec = make_word_counts()

    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    wb_all = wb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    count_all = count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    return word_all, char_all, wb_all, count_all


def fold_predictions(
    word_all,
    char_all,
    wb_all,
    count_all,
    tr_idx,
    va_idx,
    y,
):
    word_model = make_svc()
    char_model = make_svc()
    wb_model = make_svc()
    bm25_model = make_svc()
    nb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    word_model.fit(word_all[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
    char_model.fit(char_all[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
    wb_model.fit(wb_all[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])

    bm25_train = bm25_transform(count_all[tr_idx], np.arange(len(tr_idx)))
    bm25_valid_input = count_all[va_idx]
    bm25_valid = (
        bm25_transform(
            csr_matrix(np.vstack([bm25_train.shape[0] * [0]]), dtype=np.float32),
            np.array([], dtype=np.int64),
        )
        if False
        else None
    )

    # Transform train and validation together so the same fold-specific
    # BM25 IDF and average document length are used for both partitions.
    combined_counts = csr_matrix(
        np.vstack(
            [
                count_all[tr_idx].toarray(),
                count_all[va_idx].toarray(),
            ]
        ),
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    combined_bm25 = bm25_transform(
        combined_counts,
        np.arange(len(tr_idx)),
    )
    bm25_train = combined_bm25[: len(tr_idx)]
    bm25_valid = combined_bm25[len(tr_idx) :]

    bm25_model.fit(bm25_train, y[tr_idx])
    nb_model.fit(count_all[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])

    meta = np.hstack(
        [
            aligned_decision(word_model, word_all[va_idx]),
            aligned_decision(char_model, char_all[va_idx]),
            aligned_decision(wb_model, wb_all[va_idx]),
            aligned_decision(bm25_model, bm25_valid),
            aligned_logprobs(nb_model, count_all[va_idx]),
        ]
    )
    return meta


def fit_final_models(
    word_all,
    char_all,
    wb_all,
    count_all,
    n_train,
    y,
):
    word_model = make_svc()
    char_model = make_svc()
    wb_model = make_svc()
    bm25_model = make_svc()
    nb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    train_idx = np.arange(n_train)
    test_idx = np.arange(n_train, word_all.shape[0])

    word_model.fit(word_all[train_idx], y)
    char_model.fit(char_all[train_idx], y)
    wb_model.fit(wb_all[train_idx], y)

    combined_counts = csr_matrix(
        np.vstack(
            [
                count_all[train_idx].toarray(),
                count_all[test_idx].toarray(),
            ]
        ),
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    combined_bm25 = bm25_transform(
        combined_counts,
        np.arange(n_train),
    )
    bm25_train = combined_bm25[:n_train]
    bm25_test = combined_bm25[n_train:]

    bm25_model.fit(bm25_train, y)
    nb_model.fit(count_all[train_idx], y)

    test_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            aligned_decision(word_model, word_all[test_idx]),
            aligned_decision(char_model, char_all[test_idx]),
            aligned_decision(wb_model, wb_all[test_idx]),
            aligned_decision(bm25_model, bm25_test),
            aligned_logprobs(nb_model, count_all[test_idx]),
        ]
    )
    return test_meta


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected target class encountered.")

    print("Building transductive text representations...")
    word_all, char_all, wb_all, count_all = fit_views(all_text)

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    n_meta = 5 * N_CLASSES
    oof_meta = np.zeros((len(train), n_meta), dtype=np.float64)

    print("Training five folds...")
    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(train_text, y), 1):
        print(f"Fold {fold}/5")
        oof_meta[va_idx] = fold_predictions(
            word_all,
            char_all,
            wb_all,
            count_all,
            tr_idx,
            va_idx,
            y,
        )

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    best_loss = np.inf
    best_c = None

    for c_value in [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]:
        stacker = LogisticRegression(
            C=c_value,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=3000,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)
        pred = stacker.predict_proba(oof_scaled)
        score = log_loss(
            y,
            np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0),
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

        if score < best_loss:
            best_loss = score
            best_c = c_value

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=3000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {best_loss:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    print("Fitting final models...")
    test_meta = fit_final_models(
        word_all,
        char_all,
        wb_all,
        count_all,
        len(train),
        y,
    )

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(scaler.transform(test_meta))
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import gc
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?|[0-9]+|[^A-Za-z0-9\s]")


def tokenize(text):
    return TOKEN_RE.findall(text.lower())


def skip_analyzer(text):
    tokens = tokenize(text)
    out = []

    # Include ordinary unigrams so that the channel remains useful
    # for short sentences with few possible skip-gram combinations.
    out.extend("u_" + tok for tok in tokens)

    # Ordered skip-bigrams with one or two intervening tokens.
    # The explicit distance marker prevents collisions between distances.
    n = len(tokens)
    for gap in (1, 2):
        step = gap + 1
        for i in range(n - step):
            out.append(f"s{gap}_{tokens[i]}_{tokens[i + step]}")

    return out


def make_word_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=150000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=230000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_charwb_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_count_vectorizer():
    return CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=150000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_skip_vectorizer():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer=skip_analyzer,
        token_pattern=None,
        lowercase=False,
        min_df=2,
        max_features=140000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def svc_scores(model, matrix):
    return np.asarray(model.decision_function(matrix), dtype=np.float64)


def cnb_log_scores(model, matrix):
    return np.asarray(model.predict_log_proba(matrix), dtype=np.float64)


def normalized_probabilities(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    x = np.clip(x, 1e-15, None)
    return x / np.maximum(x.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-15)


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes
    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    # Fit unsupervised vocabularies and IDF values transductively.
    # Classifiers remain fold-safe because only train-fold rows are used
    # in every supervised fit.
    word_vec = make_word_tfidf()
    char_vec = make_char_tfidf()
    charwb_vec = make_charwb_tfidf()
    count_vec = make_count_vectorizer()
    skip_vec = make_skip_vectorizer()

    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    charwb_all = charwb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    count_all = count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    skip_all = skip_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    n_train = len(train_text)
    word_train, word_test = word_all[:n_train], word_all[n_train:]
    char_train, char_test = char_all[:n_train], char_all[n_train:]
    charwb_train, charwb_test = charwb_all[:n_train], charwb_all[n_train:]
    count_train, count_test = count_all[:n_train], count_all[n_train:]
    skip_train, skip_test = skip_all[:n_train], skip_all[n_train:]

    del word_all, char_all, charwb_all, count_all, skip_all, all_text
    gc.collect()

    cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 5 * N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(np.zeros(n_train), y), 1):
        print(f"fold {fold}/5")

        word_model = LinearSVC(C=2.5, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
        word_model.fit(word_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        oof_meta[va_idx, 0:3] = svc_scores(word_model, word_train[va_idx])

        char_model = LinearSVC(C=3.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
        char_model.fit(char_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        oof_meta[va_idx, 3:6] = svc_scores(char_model, char_train[va_idx])

        charwb_model = LinearSVC(C=3.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
        charwb_model.fit(charwb_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        oof_meta[va_idx, 6:9] = svc_scores(charwb_model, charwb_train[va_idx])

        cnb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.15)
        cnb_model.fit(count_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        oof_meta[va_idx, 9:12] = cnb_log_scores(cnb_model, count_train[va_idx])

        skip_model = LinearSVC(C=1.8, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
        skip_model.fit(skip_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        oof_meta[va_idx, 12:15] = svc_scores(skip_model, skip_train[va_idx])

        del (
            word_model,
            char_model,
            charwb_model,
            cnb_model,
            skip_model,
        )
        gc.collect()

    # Select stacker regularization with a separate five-fold evaluation.
    meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 101,
    )

    candidate_c = [0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    best_c = None
    best_score = np.inf

    for c_value in candidate_c:
        meta_pred = np.zeros((n_train, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

        for meta_tr, meta_va in meta_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            stacker = make_pipeline(
                StandardScaler(),
                LogisticRegression(
                    C=c_value,
                    solver="lbfgs",
                    max_iter=3000,
                    random_state=SEED,
                ),
            )
            stacker.fit(oof_meta[meta_tr], y[meta_tr])
            meta_pred[meta_va] = stacker.predict_proba(oof_meta[meta_va])

        score = log_loss(
            y,
            normalized_probabilities(meta_pred),
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

        if score < best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_c = c_value

    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {best_score:.6f}")
    print(f"selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    final_stacker = make_pipeline(
        StandardScaler(),
        LogisticRegression(
            C=best_c,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=3000,
            random_state=SEED,
        ),
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_meta, y)

    # Refit all heterogeneous base models on the complete labeled set.
    word_model = LinearSVC(C=2.5, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
    word_model.fit(word_train, y)
    test_word = svc_scores(word_model, word_test)

    char_model = LinearSVC(C=3.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
    char_model.fit(char_train, y)
    test_char = svc_scores(char_model, char_test)

    charwb_model = LinearSVC(C=3.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
    charwb_model.fit(charwb_train, y)
    test_charwb = svc_scores(charwb_model, charwb_test)

    cnb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.15)
    cnb_model.fit(count_train, y)
    test_cnb = cnb_log_scores(cnb_model, count_test)

    skip_model = LinearSVC(C=1.8, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
    skip_model.fit(skip_train, y)
    test_skip = svc_scores(skip_model, skip_test)

    test_meta = np.hstack([test_word, test_char, test_charwb, test_cnb, test_skip])

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(test_meta)
    test_pred = normalized_probabilities(test_pred)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3
PAIRS = [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2)]


def normalize_probabilities(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64)
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)
    return p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def make_word_vectorizer():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=170000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_wb_vectorizer():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=220000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def build_features(word_vectorizer, char_vectorizer, texts):
    word_x = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    char_x = char_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    return hstack([word_x, char_x], format="csr")


def fit_pairwise_models(x_train, y_train):
    models = []

    for class_a, class_b in PAIRS:
        mask = (y_train == class_a) | (y_train == class_b)
        # Class b is encoded as the positive class, so a positive margin
        # consistently means evidence for class_b over class_a.
        y_binary = (y_train[mask] == class_b).astype(np.int8)

        model = LinearSVC(
            C=1.8,
            class_weight=None,
            max_iter=5000,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        model.fit(x_train[mask], y_binary)
        models.append(model)

    return models


def pairwise_margins(models, x):
    margins = np.zeros((x.shape[0], len(PAIRS)), dtype=np.float64)

    for j, model in enumerate(models):
        margins[:, j] = model.decision_function(x)

    # Absolute margins provide a confidence channel for the calibrator.
    return np.hstack([margins, np.abs(margins)])


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes
    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected target label found.")

    # Unsupervised vocabulary and IDF are learned once from train + test.
    # Classifiers remain fold-safe because they only see fold training labels.
    word_vectorizer = make_word_vectorizer()
    char_vectorizer = make_char_wb_vectorizer()

    word_vectorizer.fit(all_text)
    char_vectorizer.fit(all_text)

    x_all = build_features(word_vectorizer, char_vectorizer, all_text)
    x_train = x_all[: len(train)]
    x_test = x_all[len(train) :]

    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    oof_meta = np.zeros((len(train), 6), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(outer_cv.split(x_train, y), start=1):
        models = fit_pairwise_models(x_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        oof_meta[va_idx] = pairwise_margins(models, x_train[va_idx])
        print(f"Pairwise fold {fold}/5 complete")

    # Select calibration strength using a separate five-fold CV over OOF margins.
    calibration_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 31,
    )

    candidate_c = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    best_c = None
    best_score = np.inf

    for c_value in candidate_c:
        calibrated_oof = np.zeros((len(train), N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

        for meta_tr, meta_va in calibration_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            calibrator = make_pipeline(
                StandardScaler(),
                LogisticRegression(
                    C=c_value,
                    solver="lbfgs",
                    max_iter=3000,
                    random_state=SEED,
                ),
            )
            calibrator.fit(oof_meta[meta_tr], y[meta_tr])
            calibrated_oof[meta_va] = calibrator.predict_proba(oof_meta[meta_va])

        score = log_loss(
            y,
            normalize_probabilities(calibrated_oof),
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

        if score < best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_c = c_value

    print(f"5-fold pairwise calibrated log loss: {best_score:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected calibrator C: {best_c}")

    final_calibrator = make_pipeline(
        StandardScaler(),
        LogisticRegression(

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def make_word_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=150000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=220000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_charwb_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 7),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=220000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_punctuation_word_tfidf():
    # Retains words, contractions, and punctuation as tokens.
    # The punctuation tokens create informative word-punctuation n-grams.
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        token_pattern=r"(?u)\b\w[\w']+\b|[^\w\s]",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=False,
        strip_accents=None,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_word_counts():
    return CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=150000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def svc_scores(model, x, n_rows):
    raw = model.decision_function(x)
    raw = np.asarray(raw, dtype=np.float64)
    if raw.ndim == 1:
        raw = np.column_stack([-raw, raw])
    out = np.zeros((n_rows, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    return out


def cnb_log_scores(model, x, n_rows):
    raw = model.predict_log_proba(x).astype(np.float64)
    out = np.full((n_rows, N_CLASSES), -30.0, dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    return out


def normalize_probabilities(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64)
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return p / np.maximum(p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-15)


def fit_base_models(x_views, y, tr_idx):
    word_svc = LinearSVC(C=2.5, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
    char_svc = LinearSVC(C=3.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
    wb_svc = LinearSVC(C=3.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
    punct_svc = LinearSVC(C=2.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
    cnb = ComplementNB(alpha=0.15)

    word_svc.fit(x_views["word"][tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
    char_svc.fit(x_views["char"][tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
    wb_svc.fit(x_views["charwb"][tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
    punct_svc.fit(x_views["punct"][tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
    cnb.fit(x_views["counts"][tr_idx], y[tr_idx])

    return word_svc, char_svc, wb_svc, punct_svc, cnb


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes
    n_train = len(train)
    n_test = len(test)

    # Unsupervised transductive vocabulary/IDF construction.
    vectorizers = {
        "word": make_word_tfidf(),
        "char": make_char_tfidf(),
        "charwb": make_charwb_tfidf(),
        "punct": make_punctuation_word_tfidf(),
        "counts": make_word_counts(),
    }

    all_features = {}
    for name, vec in vectorizers.items():
        all_features[name] = vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    x_views = {name: matrix[:n_train] for name, matrix in all_features.items()}
    x_test_views = {name: matrix[n_train:] for name, matrix in all_features.items()}

    cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 15), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(train_text, y), 1):
        models = fit_base_models(x_views, y, tr_idx)

        word_svc, char_svc, wb_svc, punct_svc, cnb = models
        blocks = [
            svc_scores(word_svc, x_views["word"][va_idx], len(va_idx)),
            svc_scores(char_svc, x_views["char"][va_idx], len(va_idx)),
            svc_scores(wb_svc, x_views["charwb"][va_idx], len(va_idx)),
            svc_scores(punct_svc, x_views["punct"][va_idx], len(va_idx)),
            cnb_log_scores(cnb, x_views["counts"][va_idx], len(va_idx)),
        ]
        oof_meta[va_idx] = np.hstack(blocks)
        print(f"base fold {fold}/5 complete")

    # Select stacker regularization using a separate five-fold evaluation
    # over strictly out-of-fold base predictions.
    meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED + 19)
    candidate_c = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    best_c = None
    best_loss = np.inf

    for c_value in candidate_c:
        meta_pred = np.zeros((n_train, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

        for meta_tr, meta_va in meta_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            stacker = make_pipeline(
                StandardScaler(),
                LogisticRegression(
                    C=c_value,
                    solver="lbfgs",
                    max_iter=3000,
                    random_state=SEED,
                ),
            )
            stacker.fit(oof_meta[meta_tr], y[meta_tr])
            meta_pred[meta_va] = stacker.predict_proba(oof_meta[meta_va])

        score = log_loss(
            y,
            normalize_probabilities(meta_pred),
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

        if score < best_loss:
            best_loss = score
            best_c = c_value

    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {best_loss:.6f}")
    print(f"selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    final_stacker = make_pipeline(
        StandardScaler(),
        LogisticRegression(
            C=best_c,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=3000,
            random_state=SEED,
        ),
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_meta, y)

    # Refit all supervised models on the full labeled data.
    final_models = fit_base_models(
        {name: all_features[name][:n_train] for name in all_features},
        y,
        np.arange(n_train),
    )

    word_svc, char_svc, wb_svc, punct_svc, cnb = final_models
    test_blocks = [
        svc_scores(word_svc, x_test_views["word"], n_test),
        svc_scores(char_svc, x_test_views["char"], n_test),
        svc_scores(wb_svc, x_test_views["charwb"], n_test),
        svc_scores(punct_svc, x_test_views["punct"], n_test),
        cnb_log_scores(cnb, x_test_views["counts"], n_test),
    ]

    test_meta = np.hstack(test_blocks)
    test_pred = normalize_probabilities(final_stacker.predict_proba(test_meta))

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy import sparse
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, normalize
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3
K_NEIGHBORS = 25


def build_vectorizers():
    return {
        "word": TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=130000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        "char": TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=170000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        "charwb": TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(3, 6),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        "binary": CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=130000,
            binary=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
    }


def aligned_scores(model, x):
    scores = model.decision_function(x)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    return out


def aligned_log_proba(model, x):
    probs = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    raw = model.predict_log_proba(x)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        probs[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]

    return probs


def retrieval_features(
    query_matrix,
    database_matrix,
    database_y,
    k=K_NEIGHBORS,
    temperature=0.08,
):
    """
    Compute similarity-weighted class probabilities using only database rows.

    Both query_matrix and database_matrix are expected to be L2-normalized.
    The sparse similarity product is explicitly densified before NumPy
    operations; np.asarray alone does not densify scipy sparse matrices.
    """
    similarities = query_matrix.dot(database_matrix.T)

    # Critical bug fix: explicitly convert sparse output to a dense ndarray.
    if sparse.issparse(similarities):
        similarities = similarities.toarray()

    similarities = np.asarray(similarities, dtype=np.float32)

    if similarities.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Expected a 2D similarity matrix, got shape {similarities.shape}."
        )

    n_query, n_database = similarities.shape

    if n_database == 0:
        raise ValueError("Retrieval database is empty.")

    k = min(k, n_database)

    # Retrieve the k largest similarities for each query.
    top_idx = np.argpartition(
        similarities,
        kth=n_database - k,
        axis=1,
    )[:, -k:]

    top_sim = np.take_along_axis(similarities, top_idx, axis=1)
    top_labels = database_y[top_idx]

    top_sim = top_sim.astype(np.float64, copy=False)
    top_labels = top_labels.astype(np.int64, copy=False)

    # Stabilized soft weighting.
    shifted = (top_sim - top_sim.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)) / temperature
    weights = np.exp(np.clip(shifted, -40.0, 0.0))

    probs = np.zeros((n_query, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for cls in range(N_CLASSES):
        probs[:, cls] = np.sum(
            weights * (top_labels == cls),
            axis=1,
        )

    probs /= np.maximum(
        probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True),
        1e-12,
    )

    max_similarity = top_sim.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    return np.hstack(
        [
            np.log(np.clip(probs, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            max_similarity,
        ]
    )


def fit_base_models(
    x_word,
    x_char,
    x_charwb,
    x_binary,
    y,
):
    models = [
        LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.20),
    ]

    models[0].fit(x_word, y)
    models[1].fit(x_char, y)
    models[2].fit(x_charwb, y)
    models[3].fit(x_binary, y)

    return models


def make_meta(
    models,
    x_word,
    x_char,
    x_charwb,
    x_binary,
    retrieval_word,
    retrieval_charwb,
    retrieval_y,
):
    word_model, char_model, charwb_model, cnb_model = models

    base_features = [
        aligned_scores(word_model, x_word),
        aligned_scores(char_model, x_char),
        aligned_scores(charwb_model, x_charwb),
        aligned_log_proba(cnb_model, x_binary),
        retrieval_features(
            x_word,
            retrieval_word,
            retrieval_y,
        ),
        retrieval_features(
            x_charwb,
            retrieval_charwb,
            retrieval_y,
        ),
    ]

    return np.hstack(base_features).astype(np.float64)


def nested_stacker_score(meta, y, cv):
    """
    Evaluate stacker regularization using a second five-fold split over
    leakage-safe out-of-fold meta-features.
    """
    c_values = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in c_values:
        predictions = np.zeros(
            (len(y), N_CLASSES),
            dtype=np.float64,
        )

        for tr_idx, va_idx in cv.split(meta, y):
            scaler = StandardScaler()

            train_meta = scaler.fit_transform(meta[tr_idx])
            valid_meta = scaler.transform(meta[va_idx])

            stacker = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=1000,
                random_state=SEED,
            )

            stacker.fit(train_meta, y[tr_idx])
            predictions[va_idx] = stacker.predict_proba(valid_meta)

        predictions = np.clip(predictions, 1e-15, 1.0)
        predictions /= predictions.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

        scores[c_value] = log_loss(
            y,
            predictions,
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)

    return best_c, scores[best_c]


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()

    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()

    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    vectorizers = build_vectorizers()

    # Transductive unsupervised feature construction.
    word_all = vectorizers["word"].fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = vectorizers["char"].fit_transform(all_text)
    charwb_all = vectorizers["charwb"].fit_transform(all_text)
    binary_all = vectorizers["binary"].fit_transform(all_text)

    n_train = len(train_text)

    word_train = word_all[:n_train]
    word_test = word_all[n_train:]

    char_train = char_all[:n_train]
    char_test = char_all[n_train:]

    charwb_train = charwb_all[:n_train]
    charwb_test = charwb_all[n_train:]

    binary_train = binary_all[:n_train]
    binary_test = binary_all[n_train:]

    # Normalize retrieval spaces once.
    word_retrieval = normalize(
        word_train,
        norm="l2",
        axis=1,
        copy=True,
    )

    charwb_retrieval = normalize(
        charwb_train,
        norm="l2",
        axis=1,
        copy=True,
    )

    word_test_retrieval = normalize(
        word_test,
        norm="l2",
        axis=1,
        copy=True,
    )

    charwb_test_retrieval = normalize(
        charwb_test,
        norm="l2",
        axis=1,
        copy=True,
    )

    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # Four base channels contribute 3 features each.
    # Two retrieval channels contribute 4 features each.
    # Total: 12 + 8 = 20 features.
    oof_meta = np.zeros(
        (n_train, 20),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(
        outer_cv.split(word_train, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        print(
            f"Processing fold {fold}/5...",
            flush=True,
        )

        models = fit_base_models(
            word_train[tr_idx],
            char_train[tr_idx],
            charwb_train[tr_idx],
            binary_train[tr_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
        )

        oof_meta[va_idx] = make_meta(
            models,
            word_train[va_idx],
            char_train[va_idx],
            charwb_train[va_idx],
            binary_train[va_idx],
            word_retrieval[tr_idx],
            charwb_retrieval[tr_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
        )

    best_c, cv_score = nested_stacker_score(
        oof_meta,
        y,
        StratifiedKFold(
            n_splits=5,
            shuffle=True,
            random_state=SEED + 1,
        ),
    )

    print(
        f"5-fold validation log loss: {cv_score:.6f}",
        flush=True,
    )
    print(
        f"Selected stacker C: {best_c}",
        flush=True,
    )

    # Fit final stacker on all out-of-fold meta-features.
    final_scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = final_scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    # Refit all base models on the complete training set.
    final_models = fit_base_models(
        word_train,
        char_train,
        charwb_train,
        binary_train,
        y,
    )

    # Generate test meta-features using all labeled training rows as retrieval
    # candidates.
    test_meta = make_meta(
        final_models,
        word_test,
        char_test,
        charwb_test,
        binary_test,
        word_retrieval,
        charwb_retrieval,
        y,
    )

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(final_scaler.transform(test_meta))

    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        test_pred,
        columns=CLASSES,
    )

    submission.insert(
        0,
        "id",
        test["id"].to_numpy(),
    )

    submission.to_csv(
        "./submission.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved ./submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.",
        flush=True,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    binary_word = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=130000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    topic_counts = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.98,
        max_features=60000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    return word, char, char_wb, case_char, binary_word, topic_counts


def fit_text_models(x_word, x_char, x_char_wb, x_case, x_binary, y):
    models = [
        LinearSVC(C=1.35, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.00, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.00, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=0.80, random_state=SEED),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.20),
    ]

    models[0].fit(x_word, y)
    models[1].fit(x_char, y)
    models[2].fit(x_char_wb, y)
    models[3].fit(x_case, y)
    models[4].fit(x_binary, y)

    return models


def text_meta_features(models, x_word, x_char, x_char_wb, x_case, x_binary):
    word_model, char_model, wb_model, case_model, cnb_model = models

    return np.hstack(
        [
            word_model.decision_function(x_word),
            char_model.decision_function(x_char),
            wb_model.decision_function(x_char_wb),
            case_model.decision_function(x_case),
            cnb_model.predict_log_proba(x_binary),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float64)


def fit_topic_model(x_topic, y):
    topic_classifier = LogisticRegression(
        C=2.0,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=500,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    topic_classifier.fit(x_topic, y)
    return topic_classifier


def choose_stacker(x_meta, y):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    x_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(x_meta)

    best_loss = np.inf
    best_c = None

    for c_value in [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0, 100.0]:
        stacker = LogisticRegression(
            C=c_value,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=1000,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        stacker.fit(x_scaled, y)
        pred = stacker.predict_proba(x_scaled)
        pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
        pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

        score = log_loss(y, pred, labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES))
        if score < best_loss:
            best_loss = score
            best_c = c_value

    return scaler, best_c, best_loss


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    word_vec, char_vec, wb_vec, case_vec, binary_vec, topic_vec = make_vectorizers()

    # Unsupervised transductive representations.
    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    wb_all = wb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    case_all = case_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    binary_all = binary_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    topic_counts_all = topic_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    # The topic basis is learned without using author labels.
    lda = LatentDirichletAllocation(
        n_components=35,
        doc_topic_prior=0.15,
        topic_word_prior=0.01,
        learning_method="online",
        learning_decay=0.7,
        learning_offset=20.0,
        max_iter=25,
        batch_size=256,
        evaluate_every=-1,
        random_state=SEED,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    topic_all = lda.fit_transform(topic_counts_all).astype(np.float32)

    n_train = len(train_text)

    word_train, word_test = word_all[:n_train], word_all[n_train:]
    char_train, char_test = char_all[:n_train], char_all[n_train:]
    wb_train, wb_test = wb_all[:n_train], wb_all[n_train:]
    case_train, case_test = case_all[:n_train], case_all[n_train:]
    binary_train, binary_test = binary_all[:n_train], binary_all[n_train:]
    topic_train, topic_test = topic_all[:n_train], topic_all[n_train:]

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # 4 SVC views + CNB = 15 features, plus 3 topic probabilities.
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 18), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(word_train, y), start=1):
        models = fit_text_models(
            word_train[tr_idx],
            char_train[tr_idx],
            wb_train[tr_idx],
            case_train[tr_idx],
            binary_train[tr_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
        )

        text_features = text_meta_features(
            models,
            word_train[va_idx],
            char_train[va_idx],
            wb_train[va_idx],
            case_train[va_idx],
            binary_train[va_idx],
        )

        topic_model = fit_topic_model(topic_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        topic_features = topic_model.predict_log_proba(topic_train[va_idx])

        oof_meta[va_idx] = np.hstack(
            [
                text_features,
                topic_features,
            ]
        )

    scaler, best_c, cv_score = choose_stacker(oof_meta, y)
    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {cv_score:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    final_models = fit_text_models(
        word_train,
        char_train,
        wb_train,
        case_train,
        binary_train,
        y,
    )

    final_topic_model = fit_topic_model(topic_train, y)

    test_text_features = text_meta_features(
        final_models,
        word_test,
        char_test,
        wb_test,
        case_test,
        binary_test,
    )
    test_topic_features = final_topic_model.predict_log_proba(topic_test)

    test_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            test_text_features,
            test_topic_features,
        ]
    )

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(scaler.transform(oof_meta), y)

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(scaler.transform(test_meta))
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB

from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def build_vectorizers():
    return [
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=150000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(2, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=150000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=False,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=150000,
            binary=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
    ]


def aligned_decision(model, x):
    scores = model.decision_function(x)
    scores = np.asarray(scores)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]
    return out


def aligned_log_proba(model, x):
    probs = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    raw = model.predict_log_proba(x)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        probs[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    return probs


def make_base_models(y):
    return [
        LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=0.8, random_state=SEED),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.20),
    ]


def produce_meta(
    models, x_word, x_char, x_charwb, x_case, x_binary, lsa_model, lsa_classifier
):
    outputs = [
        aligned_decision(models[0], x_word),
        aligned_decision(models[1], x_char),
        aligned_decision(models[2], x_charwb),
        aligned_decision(models[3], x_case),
        aligned_log_proba(models[4], x_binary),
        aligned_decision(lsa_classifier, lsa_model.transform(x_word)),
    ]
    return np.hstack(outputs).astype(np.float64)


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])
    n_train = len(train_text)

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected class label.")

    # Unsupervised transductive feature construction.
    vectorizers = build_vectorizers()
    matrices = [v.fit_transform(all_text) for v in vectorizers]

    word_all, char_all, charwb_all, case_all, binary_all = matrices

    word_train, word_test = word_all[:n_train], word_all[n_train:]
    char_train, char_test = char_all[:n_train], char_all[n_train:]
    charwb_train, charwb_test = charwb_all[:n_train], charwb_all[n_train:]
    case_train, case_test = case_all[:n_train], case_all[n_train:]
    binary_train, binary_test = binary_all[:n_train], binary_all[n_train:]

    # LSA is fitted without labels on the complete inference vocabulary.
    # It provides a compact semantic representation complementary to n-grams.
    svd = TruncatedSVD(
        n_components=160,
        n_iter=5,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    svd.fit(word_all)

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # Six base views, each producing three channels.
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 18), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(word_train, y), 1):
        print(f"fold {fold}/5")

        models = make_base_models(y[tr_idx])
        models[0].fit(word_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        models[1].fit(char_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        models[2].fit(charwb_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        models[3].fit(case_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
        models[4].fit(binary_train[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])

        # Fit the LSA classifier only using labels from the fold's train split.
        lsa_train = svd.transform(word_train[tr_idx]).astype(np.float32)
        lsa_valid = svd.transform(word_train[va_idx]).astype(np.float32)

        lsa_classifier = LogisticRegression(
            C=2.0,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=500,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        lsa_classifier.fit(lsa_train, y[tr_idx])

        oof_meta[va_idx] = produce_meta(
            models,
            word_train[va_idx],
            char_train[va_idx],
            charwb_train[va_idx],
            case_train[va_idx],
            binary_train[va_idx],
            svd,
            lsa_classifier,
        )

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    # Select stacker regularization using the complete five-fold OOF predictions.
    best_c = None
    best_loss = np.inf

    for c_value in [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0, 100.0]:
        stacker = LogisticRegression(
            C=c_value,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=1000,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)
        pred = stacker.predict_proba(oof_scaled)
        pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
        pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

        score = log_loss(y, pred, labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES))
        if score < best_loss:
            best_loss = score
            best_c = c_value

    print(f"5-fold cross-validation log loss: {best_loss:.6f}")
    print(f"selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    # Refit all sparse base models on the complete labeled dataset.
    final_models = make_base_models(y)
    final_models[0].fit(word_train, y)
    final_models[1].fit(char_train, y)
    final_models[2].fit(charwb_train, y)
    final_models[3].fit(case_train, y)
    final_models[4].fit(binary_train, y)

    # Refit the semantic classifier on all labeled examples.
    lsa_train_all = svd.transform(word_train).astype(np.float32)
    final_lsa_classifier = LogisticRegression(
        C=2.0,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=500,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_lsa_classifier.fit(lsa_train_all, y)

    test_meta = produce_meta(
        final_models,
        word_test,
        char_test,
        charwb_test,
        case_test,
        binary_test,
        svd,
        final_lsa_classifier,
    )

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(scaler.transform(test_meta))
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")

import os
import re
import random
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from nltk.stem.snowball import SnowballStemmer

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

SEED = 42
DATA_DIR = "./data"
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = len(CLASSES)

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]+(?:['’][A-Za-z]+)?")
STEMMER = SnowballStemmer("english")


def seed_everything(seed=SEED):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)


def stem_analyzer(text):
    tokens = TOKEN_RE.findall(text.lower())
    return [STEMMER.stem(token.replace("’", "'")) for token in tokens]


def make_word_vectorizer():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=1,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_stem_vectorizer():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer=stem_analyzer,
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_wb_vectorizer():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=200000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_count_vectorizer():
    return CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=180000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def aligned_decision_scores(model, matrix):
    scores = model.decision_function(matrix)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    output = np.zeros((matrix.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for col, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        output[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, col]
    return output


def aligned_log_probabilities(model, matrix):
    scores = model.predict_log_proba(matrix)
    output = np.zeros((matrix.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for col, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        output[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, col]
    return output


def fit_fold_models(
    x_word,
    x_stem,
    x_char_wb,
    x_count,
    train_indices,
    valid_indices,
    y,
):
    svc_params = {
        "C": 2.5,
        "max_iter": 6000,
        "random_state": SEED,
    }

    word_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params)
    stem_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params)
    char_wb_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params)
    count_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    word_model.fit(x_word[train_indices], y[train_indices])
    stem_model.fit(x_stem[train_indices], y[train_indices])
    char_wb_model.fit(x_char_wb[train_indices], y[train_indices])
    count_model.fit(x_count[train_indices], y[train_indices])

    meta_valid = np.hstack(
        [
            aligned_decision_scores(
                word_model,
                x_word[valid_indices],
            ),
            aligned_decision_scores(
                stem_model,
                x_stem[valid_indices],
            ),
            aligned_decision_scores(
                char_wb_model,
                x_char_wb[valid_indices],
            ),
            aligned_log_probabilities(
                count_model,
                x_count[valid_indices],
            ),
        ]
    )

    return meta_valid


def fit_final_models(x_word, x_stem, x_char_wb, x_count, y):
    svc_params = {
        "C": 2.5,
        "max_iter": 6000,
        "random_state": SEED,
    }

    word_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params).fit(x_word, y)
    stem_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params).fit(x_stem, y)
    char_wb_model = LinearSVC(**svc_params).fit(x_char_wb, y)
    count_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08).fit(x_count, y)

    return word_model, stem_model, char_wb_model, count_model


def main():
    seed_everything()

    train = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv"))
    test = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv"))

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes.astype(np.int64)

    n_train = len(train)

    word_vectorizer = make_word_vectorizer()
    stem_vectorizer = make_stem_vectorizer()
    char_wb_vectorizer = make_char_wb_vectorizer()
    count_vectorizer = make_count_vectorizer()

    word_all = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(all_text)
    stem_all = stem_vectorizer.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_wb_all = char_wb_vectorizer.fit_transform(all_text)
    count_all = count_vectorizer.fit_transform(all_text)

    x_word = word_all[:n_train]
    x_stem = stem_all[:n_train]
    x_char_wb = char_wb_all[:n_train]
    x_count = count_all[:n_train]

    x_word_test = word_all[n_train:]
    x_stem_test = stem_all[n_train:]
    x_char_wb_test = char_wb_all[n_train:]
    x_count_test = count_all[n_train:]

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # Four base models produce 12 OOF meta-features.
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 4 * N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold_number, (train_indices, valid_indices) in enumerate(
        cv.split(train_text, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        print(f"fold {fold_number}/5")

        oof_meta[valid_indices] = fit_fold_models(
            x_word=x_word,
            x_stem=x_stem,
            x_char_wb=x_char_wb,
            x_count=x_count,
            train_indices=train_indices,
            valid_indices=valid_indices,
            y=y,
        )

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    best_c = None
    best_loss = np.inf

    for c_value in [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]:
        stacker = LogisticRegression(
            C=c_value,
