import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import vstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def make_vectorizers():
    return {
        "word": TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=2,
            max_df=0.995,
            max_features=160000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        "char": TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(3, 6),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=230000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        "charwb": TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(3, 7),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=230000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        "counts": CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=2,
            max_df=0.995,
            max_features=160000,
            binary=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
    }


def svc_probability(model, x, temperature=0.40):
    scores = np.asarray(model.decision_function(x), dtype=np.float64)
    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    aligned = np.full((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), -30.0, dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        aligned[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    z = aligned / temperature
    z -= z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    p = np.exp(z)
    return p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def cnb_probability(model, x):
    p = np.asarray(model.predict_proba(x), dtype=np.float64)
    aligned = np.full((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), 1e-12, dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        aligned[:, int(cls)] = p[:, j]
    return aligned / aligned.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def fit_models(views, y, indices, extra_indices=None, extra_y=None, extra_weight=None):
    if extra_indices is None:
        train_indices = indices
        yy = y[indices]
        weights = None
    else:
        train_indices = np.concatenate([indices, extra_indices])
        yy = np.concatenate([y[indices], extra_y])
        weights = np.concatenate(
            [
                np.ones(len(indices), dtype=np.float64),
                extra_weight.astype(np.float64),
            ]
        )

    models = {
        "word": LinearSVC(C=2.5, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED),
        "char": LinearSVC(C=3.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED),
        "charwb": LinearSVC(C=3.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED),
        "cnb": ComplementNB(alpha=0.15),
    }

    if weights is None:
        models["word"].fit(views["word"][train_indices], yy)
        models["char"].fit(views["char"][train_indices], yy)
        models["charwb"].fit(views["charwb"][train_indices], yy)
        models["cnb"].fit(views["counts"][train_indices], yy)
    else:
        models["word"].fit(views["word"][train_indices], yy, sample_weight=weights)
        models["char"].fit(views["char"][train_indices], yy, sample_weight=weights)
        models["charwb"].fit(views["charwb"][train_indices], yy, sample_weight=weights)
        models["cnb"].fit(views["counts"][train_indices], yy, sample_weight=weights)

    return models


def predict_ensemble(models, views, indices):
    p_word = svc_probability(models["word"], views["word"][indices])
    p_char = svc_probability(models["char"], views["char"][indices])
    p_wb = svc_probability(models["charwb"], views["charwb"][indices])
    p_cnb = cnb_probability(models["cnb"], views["counts"][indices])

    p = 0.30 * p_word + 0.30 * p_char + 0.20 * p_wb + 0.20 * p_cnb
    return p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def choose_pseudo_labels(probabilities, threshold=0.98, cap_per_class=1400):
    confidence = probabilities.max(axis=1)
    labels = probabilities.argmax(axis=1)

    selected = []
    for cls in range(N_CLASSES):
        candidates = np.flatnonzero((labels == cls) & (confidence >= threshold))
        if len(candidates) > cap_per_class:
            order = np.argsort(confidence[candidates])[::-1]
            candidates = candidates[order[:cap_per_class]]
        selected.append(candidates)

    if not selected:
        return np.array([], dtype=np.int64), np.array([], dtype=np.int64), np.array([])

    selected_idx = np.concatenate(selected)
    pseudo_y = labels[selected_idx]
    pseudo_conf = confidence[selected_idx]

    order = np.argsort(selected_idx)
    return selected_idx[order], pseudo_y[order], pseudo_conf[order]


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes
    n_train = len(train)
    n_test = len(test)

    vectorizers = make_vectorizers()
    all_features = {}

    for name, vectorizer in vectorizers.items():
        all_features[name] = vectorizer.fit_transform(all_text)

    views = {name: matrix[:n_train] for name, matrix in all_features.items()}
    test_views = {name: matrix[n_train:] for name, matrix in all_features.items()}

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    fold_losses = []
    test_predictions_from_folds = []

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(train_text, y), 1):
        base_models = fit_models(views, y, tr_idx)

        validation_base = predict_ensemble(base_models, views, va_idx)
        test_base = predict_ensemble(base_models, test_views, np.arange(n_test))

        pseudo_idx, pseudo_y, pseudo_conf = choose_pseudo_labels(
            test_base,
            threshold=0.98,
            cap_per_class=1400,
        )

        if len(pseudo_idx) > 0:
            pseudo_views = {name: test_views[name][pseudo_idx] for name in test_views}

            augmented_views = {
                name: vstack([views[name][tr_idx], pseudo_views[name]])
                for name in views
            }
            augmented_y = np.concatenate(
                [
                    y[tr_idx],
                    pseudo_y,
                ]
            )
            augmented_weights = np.concatenate(
                [
                    np.ones(len(tr_idx), dtype=np.float64),
                    0.25 + 0.50 * pseudo_conf,
                ]
            )

            augmented_models = fit_models(
                augmented_views,
                augmented_y,
                np.arange(len(augmented_y)),
                extra_indices=None,
                extra_y=None,
                extra_weight=None,
            )

            validation_augmented = predict_ensemble(
                augmented_models,
                {
                    name: vstack([views[name][va_idx], views[name][va_idx]])
                    for name in views
                },
                np.arange(len(va_idx)),
            )
        else:
            augmented_models = base_models
            validation_augmented = validation_base

        # Conservative blend prevents a small pseudo-label set from
        # overwhelming the reliable supervised model.
        validation_pred = 0.45 * validation_base + 0.55 * validation_augmented
        validation_pred = np.clip(validation_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
        validation_pred /= validation_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

        fold_loss = log_loss(
            y[va_idx],
            validation_pred,
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )
        fold_losses.append(fold_loss)

        # Keep the augmented test prediction for cross-fold bagging.
        if len(pseudo_idx) > 0:
            augmented_test_pred = predict_ensemble(
                augmented_models,
                {
                    name: vstack([views[name][tr_idx], test_views[name][pseudo_idx]])
                    for name in views
                },
                (
                    np.arange(n_train - len(tr_idx), n_train - len(tr_idx) + n_test)
                    if False
                    else np.arange(n_test)
                ),
            )
        else:
            augmented_test_pred = test_base

        test_predictions_from_folds.append(
            0.45 * test_base + 0.55 * augmented_test_pred
        )

        print(
            f"fold {fold}/5 log loss: {fold_loss:.6f}; "
            f"pseudo-labels: {len(pseudo_idx)}"
        )

    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {np.mean(fold_losses):.6f}")

    # Final full-data supervised model.
    full_models = fit_models(
        views,
        y,
        np.arange(n_train),
    )
    full_test_base = predict_ensemble(
        full_models,
        test_views,
        np.arange(n_test),
    )

    # Generate final pseudo-labels and retrain using them.
    pseudo_idx, pseudo_y, pseudo_conf = choose_pseudo_labels(
        full_test_base,
        threshold=0.98,
        cap_per_class=1800,
    )

    if len(pseudo_idx) > 0:
        combined_views = {
            name: vstack([views[name], test_views[name][pseudo_idx]]) for name in views
        }
        combined_y = np.concatenate([y, pseudo_y])
        combined_weights = np.concatenate(
            [
                np.ones(n_train, dtype=np.float64),
                0.25 + 0.50 * pseudo_conf,
            ]
        )

        augmented_models = fit_models(
            combined_views,
            combined_y,
            np.arange(len(combined_y)),
        )

        # The combined model is evaluated on the test distribution, but the
        # final prediction remains blended with the original full-data model.
        augmented_test = predict_ensemble(
            augmented_models,
            {
                name: vstack(
                    [
                        views[name],
                        test_views[name][pseudo_idx],
                    ]
                )
                for name in views
            },
            np.arange(n_test),
        )
    else:
        augmented_test = full_test_base

    fold_bagged = np.mean(
        np.stack(test_predictions_from_folds, axis=0),
        axis=0,
    )

    final_pred = 0.50 * full_test_base + 0.25 * augmented_test + 0.25 * fold_bagged
    final_pred = np.clip(final_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    final_pred /= final_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(final_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def fit_models(
    views,
    y,
    indices,
    extra_indices=None,
    extra_y=None,
    extra_weight=None,
    sample_weight=None,
):
    """
    Fit the four base models.

    Two fitting modes are supported:
    - Standard mode: fit views[feature][indices] using y[indices].
    - Combined mode: fit a matrix that is already vertically combined,
      using all supplied indices and sample_weight.
    """
    indices = np.asarray(indices, dtype=np.int64)

    if extra_indices is not None:
        extra_indices = np.asarray(extra_indices, dtype=np.int64)

        train_indices = np.concatenate([indices, extra_indices])
        yy = np.concatenate([y[indices], extra_y])

        if extra_weight is None:
            weights = np.ones(len(train_indices), dtype=np.float64)
        else:
            weights = np.concatenate(
                [
                    np.ones(len(indices), dtype=np.float64),
                    np.asarray(extra_weight, dtype=np.float64),
                ]
            )
    else:
        train_indices = indices
        yy = y[indices]

        if sample_weight is None:
            weights = None
        else:
            weights = np.asarray(sample_weight, dtype=np.float64)
            if len(weights) != len(train_indices):
                raise ValueError("sample_weight must have one value per training row.")

    models = {
        "word": LinearSVC(
            C=2.5,
            max_iter=5000,
            random_state=SEED,
        ),
        "char": LinearSVC(
            C=3.0,
            max_iter=5000,
            random_state=SEED,
        ),
        "charwb": LinearSVC(
            C=3.0,
            max_iter=5000,
            random_state=SEED,
        ),
        "cnb": ComplementNB(alpha=0.15),
    }

    feature_model_pairs = [
        ("word", "word"),
        ("char", "char"),
        ("charwb", "charwb"),
        ("cnb", "counts"),
    ]

    for model_name, feature_name in feature_model_pairs:
        x_train = views[feature_name][train_indices]

        if weights is None:
            models[model_name].fit(x_train, yy)
        else:
            models[model_name].fit(
                x_train,
                yy,
                sample_weight=weights,
            )

    return models


def predict_ensemble(models, views, indices):
    indices = np.asarray(indices, dtype=np.int64)

    p_word = svc_probability(
        models["word"],
        views["word"][indices],
    )
    p_char = svc_probability(
        models["char"],
        views["char"][indices],
    )
    p_wb = svc_probability(
        models["charwb"],
        views["charwb"][indices],
    )
    p_cnb = cnb_probability(
        models["cnb"],
        views["counts"][indices],
    )

    p = 0.30 * p_word + 0.30 * p_char + 0.20 * p_wb + 0.20 * p_cnb

    return p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def choose_pseudo_labels(
    probabilities,
    threshold=0.98,
    cap_per_class=1400,
):
    confidence = probabilities.max(axis=1)
    labels = probabilities.argmax(axis=1)

    selected_by_class = []

    for cls in range(N_CLASSES):
        candidates = np.flatnonzero((labels == cls) & (confidence >= threshold))

        if len(candidates) > cap_per_class:
            order = np.argsort(confidence[candidates])[::-1]
            candidates = candidates[order[:cap_per_class]]

        selected_by_class.append(candidates)

    selected_idx = np.concatenate(selected_by_class)

    if len(selected_idx) == 0:
        return (
            np.array([], dtype=np.int64),
            np.array([], dtype=np.int64),
            np.array([], dtype=np.float64),
        )

    pseudo_y = labels[selected_idx]
    pseudo_conf = confidence[selected_idx]

    order = np.argsort(selected_idx)

    return (
        selected_idx[order].astype(np.int64),
        pseudo_y[order].astype(np.int64),
        pseudo_conf[order].astype(np.float64),
    )


def normalize_predictions(predictions):
    predictions = np.clip(
        predictions,
        1e-15,
        1.0,
    )
    return predictions / predictions.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()

    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes.astype(np.int64)

    n_train = len(train)
    n_test = len(test)

    # Transductive feature construction: fit vectorizers on train + test.
    vectorizers = make_vectorizers()
    all_features = {}

    for name, vectorizer in vectorizers.items():
        print(f"Building {name} features...")
        all_features[name] = vectorizer.fit_transform(all_text)

    views = {name: matrix[:n_train] for name, matrix in all_features.items()}
    test_views = {name: matrix[n_train:] for name, matrix in all_features.items()}

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    fold_losses = []
    test_predictions_from_folds = []

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(
        cv.split(train_text, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        base_models = fit_models(
            views,
            y,
            tr_idx,
        )

        validation_base = predict_ensemble(
            base_models,
            views,
            va_idx,
        )
        test_base = predict_ensemble(
            base_models,
            test_views,
            np.arange(n_test),
        )

        pseudo_idx, pseudo_y, pseudo_conf = choose_pseudo_labels(
            test_base,
            threshold=0.98,
            cap_per_class=1400,
        )

        if len(pseudo_idx) > 0:
            pseudo_views = {name: test_views[name][pseudo_idx] for name in test_views}

            # This stacked matrix is used only for training.
            augmented_views = {
                name: vstack(
                    [
                        views[name][tr_idx],
                        pseudo_views[name],
                    ]
                )
                for name in views
            }

            augmented_y = np.concatenate(
                [
                    y[tr_idx],
                    pseudo_y,
                ]
            )

            augmented_weights = np.concatenate(
                [
                    np.ones(len(tr_idx), dtype=np.float64),
                    0.25 + 0.50 * pseudo_conf,
                ]
            )

            # Correctly apply reduced weights to pseudo-labeled rows.
            augmented_models = fit_models(
                augmented_views,
                augmented_y,
                np.arange(len(augmented_y)),
                sample_weight=augmented_weights,
            )

            # Correctly predict validation rows directly using their
            # original feature matrices; no stacked-row offset is needed.
            validation_augmented = predict_ensemble(
                augmented_models,
                views,
                va_idx,
            )
        else:
            augmented_models = base_models
            validation_augmented = validation_base

        validation_pred = 0.45 * validation_base + 0.55 * validation_augmented
        validation_pred = normalize_predictions(validation_pred)

        fold_loss = log_loss(
            y[va_idx],
            validation_pred,
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )
        fold_losses.append(fold_loss)

        # Correctly predict the test set directly from test_views.
        if len(pseudo_idx) > 0:
            augmented_test_pred = predict_ensemble(
                augmented_models,
                test_views,
                np.arange(n_test),
            )
        else:
            augmented_test_pred = test_base

        fold_test_pred = 0.45 * test_base + 0.55 * augmented_test_pred
        fold_test_pred = normalize_predictions(fold_test_pred)
        test_predictions_from_folds.append(fold_test_pred)

        print(
            f"fold {fold}/5 log loss: {fold_loss:.6f}; "
            f"pseudo-labels: {len(pseudo_idx)}"
        )

    mean_cv_loss = float(np.mean(fold_losses))
    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {mean_cv_loss:.6f}")

    # Full-data supervised model.
    full_models = fit_models(
        views,
        y,
        np.arange(n_train),
    )

    full_test_base = predict_ensemble(
        full_models,
        test_views,
        np.arange(n_test),
    )

    # Full-data pseudo-label augmentation.
    pseudo_idx, pseudo_y, pseudo_conf = choose_pseudo_labels(
        full_test_base,
        threshold=0.98,
        cap_per_class=1800,
    )

    if len(pseudo_idx) > 0:
        combined_views = {
            name: vstack(
                [
                    views[name],
                    test_views[name][pseudo_idx],
                ]
            )
            for name in views
        }

        combined_y = np.concatenate(
            [
                y,
                pseudo_y,
            ]
        )

        combined_weights = np.concatenate(
            [
                np.ones(n_train, dtype=np.float64),
                0.25 + 0.50 * pseudo_conf,
            ]
        )

        # Correctly apply pseudo-label confidence weights.
        augmented_models = fit_models(
            combined_views,
            combined_y,
            np.arange(len(combined_y)),
            sample_weight=combined_weights,
        )

        # Correctly predict test rows directly from test_views.
        augmented_test = predict_ensemble(
            augmented_models,
            test_views,
            np.arange(n_test),
        )
    else:
        augmented_test = full_test_base

    fold_bagged = np.mean(
        np.stack(test_predictions_from_folds, axis=0),
        axis=0,
    )

    final_pred = 0.50 * full_test_base + 0.25 * augmented_test + 0.25 * fold_bagged
    final_pred = normalize_predictions(final_pred)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        final_pred,
        columns=CLASSES,
    )
    submission.insert(
        0,
        "id",
        test["id"].to_numpy(),
    )
    submission.to_csv(
        "./submission.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    print(f"saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = len(CLASSES)


def softmax(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    x = x - np.max(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(np.clip(x, -50.0, 50.0))
    return e / np.maximum(e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-15)


def svc_probabilities(model, x):
    return softmax(model.decision_function(x))


def build_vectorizers():
    return [
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=150000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=150000,
            binary=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
    ]


def fit_base_models(features, indices, y):
    word, char, charwb, binary = features

    models = [
        LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.20),
    ]

    models[0].fit(word[indices], y[indices])
    models[1].fit(char[indices], y[indices])
    models[2].fit(charwb[indices], y[indices])
    models[3].fit(binary[indices], y[indices])

    return models


def predict_base_probabilities(models, features, indices):
    word, char, charwb, binary = features

    p_word = svc_probabilities(models[0], word[indices])
    p_char = svc_probabilities(models[1], char[indices])
    p_charwb = svc_probabilities(models[2], charwb[indices])
    p_cnb = np.exp(models[3].predict_log_proba(binary[indices]))

    p_cnb = np.clip(p_cnb, 1e-15, 1.0)
    p_cnb /= p_cnb.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    # Dirichlet calibration operates on log probabilities from every view.
    probabilities = np.hstack([p_word, p_char, p_charwb, p_cnb])
    probabilities = np.clip(probabilities, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return np.log(probabilities).astype(np.float64)


def fit_dirichlet_calibrator(x, y, c_value):
    # Logistic regression on log probabilities is multiclass Dirichlet calibration.
    model = LogisticRegression(
        C=c_value,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    model.fit(x, y)
    return model


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    vectorizers = build_vectorizers()
    all_features = [v.fit_transform(all_text) for v in vectorizers]

    n_train = len(train_text)
    features = [matrix[:n_train].tocsr() for matrix in all_features]
    test_features = [matrix[n_train:].tocsr() for matrix in all_features]

    # Outer five-fold CV generates leakage-safe base-model probabilities.
    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    n_meta_features = 4 * N_CLASSES
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, n_meta_features), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (fit_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(outer_cv.split(features[0], y), 1):
        models = fit_base_models(features, fit_idx, y)
        oof_meta[valid_idx] = predict_base_probabilities(
            models,
            features,
            valid_idx,
        )
        print(f"Completed outer fold {fold}/5")

    # Honest model-selection CV over the OOF predictions.
    calibration_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 17,
    )

    candidate_c = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    validation_scores = {}

    for c_value in candidate_c:
        heldout_pred = np.zeros((n_train, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

        for cal_fit_idx, cal_valid_idx in calibration_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            calibrator = fit_dirichlet_calibrator(
                oof_meta[cal_fit_idx],
                y[cal_fit_idx],
                c_value,
            )
            heldout_pred[cal_valid_idx] = calibrator.predict_proba(
                oof_meta[cal_valid_idx]
            )

        heldout_pred = np.clip(heldout_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
        heldout_pred /= heldout_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        validation_scores[c_value] = log_loss(
            y,
            heldout_pred,
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

    best_c = min(validation_scores, key=validation_scores.get)
    best_score = validation_scores[best_c]

    print(f"Dirichlet-calibrated 5-fold log loss: {best_score:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected calibrator C: {best_c}")

    # Fit the selected calibrator on all leakage-safe OOF predictions.
    final_calibrator = fit_dirichlet_calibrator(
        oof_meta,
        y,
        best_c,
    )

    # Refit every base model on all labeled data.
    all_indices = np.arange(n_train)
    final_models = fit_base_models(features, all_indices, y)

    # Generate test base log probabilities and apply Dirichlet calibration.
    test_meta = predict_base_probabilities(
        final_models,
        test_features,
        np.arange(len(test_text)),
    )

    test_pred = final_calibrator.predict_proba(test_meta)
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def make_vectorizers():
    return [
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=130000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=130000,
            binary=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
    ]


def softmax_rows(x, temperature=1.0):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64) / temperature
    x = x - np.max(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(np.clip(x, -50.0, 50.0))
    return e / np.maximum(e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-15)


def align_scores(model, x):
    scores = model.decision_function(x)
    scores = np.asarray(scores)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    out = np.zeros((scores.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]
    return out


def align_log_probs(model, x):
    lp = model.predict_log_proba(x)
    out = np.full((lp.shape[0], N_CLASSES), -30.0, dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = lp[:, j]
    return out


def train_base_models(x_views, y):
    word_model = LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED)
    char_model = LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED)
    charwb_model = LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED)
    cnb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.20)

    word_model.fit(x_views[0], y)
    char_model.fit(x_views[1], y)
    charwb_model.fit(x_views[2], y)
    cnb_model.fit(x_views[3], y)

    return [word_model, char_model, charwb_model, cnb_model]


def base_outputs(models, x_views):
    word_margin = align_scores(models[0], x_views[0])
    char_margin = align_scores(models[1], x_views[1])
    charwb_margin = align_scores(models[2], x_views[2])
    cnb_logprob = align_log_probs(models[3], x_views[3])

    # Convert every model output to a comparable probability representation.
    word_prob = softmax_rows(word_margin, temperature=0.35)
    char_prob = softmax_rows(char_margin, temperature=0.35)
    charwb_prob = softmax_rows(charwb_margin, temperature=0.35)
    cnb_prob = np.exp(np.clip(cnb_logprob, -40.0, 0.0))
    cnb_prob /= np.maximum(cnb_prob.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-15)

    margins = np.hstack([word_margin, char_margin, charwb_margin, cnb_logprob])

    probs = np.stack(
        [word_prob, char_prob, charwb_prob, cnb_prob],
        axis=1,
    )  # rows x models x classes

    # Confidence and uncertainty of each base learner.
    confidence = probs.max(axis=2)
    entropy = -(probs * np.log(np.clip(probs, 1e-15, 1.0))).sum(axis=2)

    # Pairwise agreement: dot product and L1 disagreement.
    pair_features = []
    for i in range(4):
        for j in range(i + 1, 4):
            agreement = (probs[:, i, :] * probs[:, j, :]).sum(axis=1)
            disagreement = np.abs(probs[:, i, :] - probs[:, j, :]).sum(axis=1)
            pair_features.extend([agreement, disagreement])

    # Explicit cross-view class differences, useful when one view is unreliable.
    differences = []
    for i, j in [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3), (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3)]:
        differences.append(probs[:, i, :] - probs[:, j, :])

    meta = np.hstack(
        [
            margins,
            probs.reshape(probs.shape[0], -1),
            confidence,
            entropy,
            np.column_stack(pair_features),
            np.hstack(differences),
        ]
    )

    return meta.astype(np.float64)


def choose_stacker(meta, y):
    # Separate five-fold validation over OOF meta-features.
    inner_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 17,
    )

    candidates = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in candidates:
        pred = np.zeros((len(y), N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

        for tr_idx, va_idx in inner_cv.split(meta, y):
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            x_tr = scaler.fit_transform(meta[tr_idx])
            x_va = scaler.transform(meta[va_idx])

            model = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=1000,
                random_state=SEED,
            )
            model.fit(x_tr, y[tr_idx])
            p = model.predict_proba(x_va)

            aligned = np.zeros((len(va_idx), N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
            for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
                aligned[:, int(cls)] = p[:, j]
            pred[va_idx] = aligned

        pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
        pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        scores[c_value] = log_loss(y, pred, labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES))

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)
    print(f"5-fold meta-validation log loss: {scores[best_c]:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    meta_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(meta)

    stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    stacker.fit(meta_scaled, y)

    return scaler, stacker, best_c


def aligned_predict_proba(model, x):
    p = model.predict_proba(x)
    out = np.zeros((len(x), N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = p[:, j]
    return out


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    # Unsupervised transductive vocabulary and IDF construction.
    vectorizers = make_vectorizers()
    matrices = [v.fit_transform(all_text) for v in vectorizers]

    n_train = len(train_text)
    train_views = [m[:n_train] for m in matrices]
    test_views = [m[n_train:] for m in matrices]

    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 4 * 3 + 4 * 3 + 4 + 4 + 12 + 18), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(outer_cv.split(train_views[0], y), 1):
        print(f"Fitting outer fold {fold}/5")

        fold_train_views = [x[tr_idx] for x in train_views]
        fold_valid_views = [x[va_idx] for x in train_views]

        models = train_base_models(fold_train_views, y[tr_idx])
        oof_meta[va_idx] = base_outputs(models, fold_valid_views)

    scaler, stacker, best_c = choose_stacker(oof_meta, y)

    # Refit all base learners on the full labeled data.
    final_models = train_base_models(train_views, y)
    test_meta = base_outputs(final_models, test_views)

    test_pred = aligned_predict_proba(
        stacker,
        scaler.transform(test_meta),
    )
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import re
import random
from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

SEED = 42
DATA_DIR = "./data"
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


def seed_everything(seed=SEED):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def tokenize(text):
    return re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+(?:['’][A-Za-z]+)?", text.lower())


def build_cnn_matrix(texts, max_vocab=30000, max_len=80):
    counter = Counter()
    tokenized = []
    for text in texts:
        toks = tokenize(text)
        tokenized.append(toks)
        counter.update(toks)

    vocab = {"<PAD>": 0, "<UNK>": 1}
    for word, _ in counter.most_common(max_vocab - 2):
        vocab[word] = len(vocab)

    matrix = np.zeros((len(texts), max_len), dtype=np.int64)
    for i, toks in enumerate(tokenized):
        ids = [vocab.get(t, 1) for t in toks[:max_len]]
        if ids:
            matrix[i, : len(ids)] = ids
    return matrix, len(vocab)


class WordCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, emb_dim=96, channels=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, emb_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Conv1d(emb_dim, channels, kernel_size=k) for k in (3, 4, 5)]
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.35)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(channels * 3, N_CLASSES)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.embedding(x).transpose(1, 2)
        pooled = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            h = torch.relu(conv(x))
            h = torch.max(h, dim=2).values
            pooled.append(h)
        h = self.dropout(torch.cat(pooled, dim=1))
        return self.fc(h)


def train_cnn(x, y, train_idx, valid_idx, vocab_size, epochs=7):
    model = WordCNN(vocab_size).to(DEVICE)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    train_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(x[train_idx]),
        torch.from_numpy(y[train_idx]).long(),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds,
        batch_size=256,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=0,
        pin_memory=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"),
    )

    model.train()
    for _ in range(epochs):
        for xb, yb in loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            loss = criterion(model(xb), yb)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 3.0)
            optimizer.step()

    def predict(indices):
        model.eval()
        outputs = []
        ds = TensorDataset(torch.from_numpy(x[indices]))
        dl = DataLoader(
            ds,
            batch_size=512,
            shuffle=False,
            num_workers=0,
            pin_memory=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"),
        )
        with torch.no_grad():
            for (xb,) in dl:
                xb = xb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
                outputs.append(torch.log_softmax(model(xb), dim=1).cpu().numpy())
        return np.vstack(outputs)

    valid_logp = predict(valid_idx)
    return model, valid_logp


def fit_cnn_full(x, y, vocab_size, epochs=8):
    model = WordCNN(vocab_size).to(DEVICE)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    ds = TensorDataset(torch.from_numpy(x), torch.from_numpy(y).long())
    loader = DataLoader(
        ds,
        batch_size=256,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=0,
        pin_memory=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"),
    )

    model.train()
    for _ in range(epochs):
        for xb, yb in loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            loss = criterion(model(xb), yb)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 3.0)
            optimizer.step()
    return model


def cnn_predict(model, x, indices):
    model.eval()
    outputs = []
    ds = TensorDataset(torch.from_numpy(x[indices]))
    dl = DataLoader(
        ds,
        batch_size=512,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=0,
        pin_memory=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"),
    )
    with torch.no_grad():
        for (xb,) in dl:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            outputs.append(torch.log_softmax(model(xb), dim=1).cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(outputs)


def sparse_models_and_features(texts):
    word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=150000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    charwb_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    count_vec = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=150000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    return (
        word_vec.fit_transform(texts),
        char_vec.fit_transform(texts),
        charwb_vec.fit_transform(texts),
        count_vec.fit_transform(texts),
        word_vec,
        char_vec,
        charwb_vec,
        count_vec,
    )


def sparse_meta_fit_predict(
    xw_tr, xw_va, xc_tr, xc_va, xwb_tr, xwb_va, xcnt_tr, xcnt_va, y_tr
):
    word_model = LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED)
    char_model = LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED)
    charwb_model = LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED)
    cnb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.20)

    word_model.fit(xw_tr, y_tr)
    char_model.fit(xc_tr, y_tr)
    charwb_model.fit(xwb_tr, y_tr)
    cnb_model.fit(xcnt_tr, y_tr)

    return np.hstack(
        [
            word_model.decision_function(xw_va),
            char_model.decision_function(xc_va),
            charwb_model.decision_function(xwb_va),
            cnb_model.predict_log_proba(xcnt_va),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float64)


def sparse_full_models_predict(
    xw_tr, xw_te, xc_tr, xc_te, xwb_tr, xwb_te, xcnt_tr, xcnt_te, y
):
    word_model = LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED).fit(xw_tr, y)
    char_model = LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED).fit(xc_tr, y)
    charwb_model = LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED).fit(xwb_tr, y)
    cnb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.20).fit(xcnt_tr, y)

    return np.hstack(
        [
            word_model.decision_function(xw_te),
            char_model.decision_function(xc_te),
            charwb_model.decision_function(xwb_te),
            cnb_model.predict_log_proba(xcnt_te),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float64)


def main():
    seed_everything()

    train = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv"))
    test = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv"))

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])
    n_train = len(train_text)

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes.astype(np.int64)

    x_word, x_char, x_charwb, x_count, *_ = sparse_models_and_features(all_text)
    cnn_x, vocab_size = build_cnn_matrix(all_text)

    xw_tr, xw_te = x_word[:n_train], x_word[n_train:]
    xc_tr, xc_te = x_char[:n_train], x_char[n_train:]
    xwb_tr, xwb_te = x_charwb[:n_train], x_charwb[n_train:]
    xcnt_tr, xcnt_te = x_count[:n_train], x_count[n_train:]
    cnn_tr = cnn_x[:n_train]
    cnn_te = cnn_x[n_train:]

    cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 15), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(xw_tr, y), 1):
        sparse_meta = sparse_meta_fit_predict(
            xw_tr[tr_idx],
            xw_tr[va_idx],
            xc_tr[tr_idx],
            xc_tr[va_idx],
            xwb_tr[tr_idx],
            xwb_tr[va_idx],
            xcnt_tr[tr_idx],
            xcnt_tr[va_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
        )
        _, cnn_logp = train_cnn(cnn_tr, y, tr_idx, va_idx, vocab_size)
        oof_meta[va_idx] = np.hstack([sparse_meta, cnn_logp])
        print(f"completed fold {fold}/5", flush=True)

    # Leakage-safe second-stage validation for stacker selection.
    meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED + 17)
    candidates = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in candidates:
        pred = np.zeros((n_train, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
        for meta_tr, meta_va in meta_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            z_tr = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta[meta_tr])
            z_va = scaler.transform(oof_meta[meta_va])
            stacker = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=600,
                random_state=SEED,
            )
            stacker.fit(z_tr, y[meta_tr])
            pred[meta_va] = stacker.predict_proba(z_va)
        scores[c_value] = log_loss(
            y, np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0), labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES)
        )

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)
    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {scores[best_c]:.6f}")
    print(f"selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    meta_scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = meta_scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)
    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=700,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    sparse_test_meta = sparse_full_models_predict(
        xw_tr,
        xw_te,
        xc_tr,
        xc_te,
        xwb_tr,
        xwb_te,
        xcnt_tr,
        xcnt_te,
        y,
    )

    final_cnn = fit_cnn_full(cnn_tr, y, vocab_size)
    cnn_test_logp = cnn_predict(final_cnn, cnn_te, np.arange(len(cnn_te)))
    test_meta = np.hstack([sparse_test_meta, cnn_test_logp])

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(meta_scaler.transform(test_meta))
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

SEED = 42
DATA_DIR = "./data"
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def aligned_decision(model, x):
    scores = np.asarray(model.decision_function(x), dtype=np.float64)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    result = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        result[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]
    return result


def aligned_log_probability(model, x):
    raw = np.asarray(model.predict_log_proba(x), dtype=np.float64)
    result = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        result[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    return result


def build_vectorizers():
    return [
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=180000,
            binary=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
    ]


def make_base_models():
    return [
        LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=0.9, random_state=SEED),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.20),
    ]


def make_length_features(texts):
    # Deterministic, label-free sentence length measurements.
    chars = np.asarray([len(x) for x in texts], dtype=np.float64)
    words = np.asarray([len(x.split()) for x in texts], dtype=np.float64)

    log_chars = np.log1p(chars)
    log_words = np.log1p(words)

    def zscore(v):
        return (v - v.mean()) / (v.std() + 1e-8)

    continuous = np.column_stack(
        [
            zscore(log_chars),
            zscore(log_words),
        ]
    )

    # Fixed bins prevent information leakage and make the gate interpretable.
    bins = np.column_stack(
        [
            (words <= 5).astype(np.float64),
            ((words > 5) & (words <= 12)).astype(np.float64),
            ((words > 12) & (words <= 25)).astype(np.float64),
            (words > 25).astype(np.float64),
        ]
    )

    return np.hstack([continuous, bins]).astype(np.float64)


def make_meta_features(base_outputs, length_features):
    """
    base_outputs has shape (n, 12): four model outputs, each with 3 channels.
    The calibrator receives:
      - raw base outputs,
      - length features,
      - every base output multiplied by continuous length features,
      - every base output multiplied by length-bin indicators.
    """
    n = base_outputs.shape[0]
    continuous = length_features[:, :2]
    bins = length_features[:, 2:]

    interactions_cont = np.hstack(
        [base_outputs * continuous[:, [j]] for j in range(continuous.shape[1])]
    )

    interactions_bins = np.hstack(
        [base_outputs * bins[:, [j]] for j in range(bins.shape[1])]
    )

    return np.hstack(
        [
            base_outputs,
            length_features,
            interactions_cont,
            interactions_bins,
        ]
    ).reshape(n, -1)


def train_base_outputs(
    models,
    matrices_train,
    fit_idx,
    pred_idx,
):
    fitted = []
    for model, matrix in zip(models, matrices_train):
        model.fit(matrix[fit_idx], y_global[fit_idx])
        fitted.append(model)

    outputs = [
        aligned_decision(fitted[0], matrices_train[0][pred_idx]),
        aligned_decision(fitted[1], matrices_train[1][pred_idx]),
        aligned_decision(fitted[2], matrices_train[2][pred_idx]),
        aligned_log_probability(fitted[3], matrices_train[3][pred_idx]),
    ]
    return np.hstack(outputs), fitted


def fit_calibrator(x_train, y_train, c_value):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    x_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(x_train)

    model = LogisticRegression(
        C=c_value,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1200,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    model.fit(x_scaled, y_train)
    return scaler, model


def calibrated_predict(scaler, model, x):
    pred = model.predict_proba(scaler.transform(x))
    pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return pred


def main():
    global y_global

    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])
    n_train = len(train_text)

    y_global = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y_global < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label encountered.")

    # Unsupervised transductive construction; labels remain fold-specific.
    vectorizers = build_vectorizers()
    all_matrices = [v.fit_transform(all_text) for v in vectorizers]

    train_matrices = [matrix[:n_train] for matrix in all_matrices]
    test_matrices = [matrix[n_train:] for matrix in all_matrices]

    length_train = make_length_features(train_text)

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

SEED = 42
DATA_DIR = "./data"
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def aligned_decision(model, x):
    scores = np.asarray(model.decision_function(x), dtype=np.float64)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    result = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        result[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    return result


def aligned_log_probability(model, x):
    raw = np.asarray(model.predict_log_proba(x), dtype=np.float64)
    result = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        result[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]

    return result


def build_vectorizers():
    return [
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(3, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=180000,
            binary=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
    ]


def make_base_models():
    return [
        LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=0.9, random_state=SEED),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.20),
    ]


def raw_length_values(texts):
    chars = np.asarray([len(x) for x in texts], dtype=np.float64)
    words = np.asarray([len(x.split()) for x in texts], dtype=np.float64)

    log_chars = np.log1p(chars)
    log_words = np.log1p(words)

    continuous = np.column_stack([log_chars, log_words])
    return continuous, words


def fit_length_statistics(texts):
    continuous, _ = raw_length_values(texts)
    mean = continuous.mean(axis=0)
    std = continuous.std(axis=0)

    # Avoid division by zero while retaining the training-derived scaling.
    std = np.maximum(std, 1e-8)
    return mean, std


def make_length_features(texts, mean, std):
    """
    Transform sentence lengths using statistics computed on the training set.
    The same mean/std must be reused for train and test data.
    """
    continuous, words = raw_length_values(texts)
    continuous = (continuous - mean) / std

    bins = np.column_stack(
        [
            (words <= 5).astype(np.float64),
            ((words > 5) & (words <= 12)).astype(np.float64),
            ((words > 12) & (words <= 25)).astype(np.float64),
            (words > 25).astype(np.float64),
        ]
    )

    return np.hstack([continuous, bins]).astype(np.float64)


def make_meta_features(base_outputs, length_features):
    """
    base_outputs has shape (n, 12): four models x three channels.

    Meta-features include:
      - raw base outputs,
      - continuous and binned length features,
      - interactions between base outputs and continuous lengths,
      - interactions between base outputs and length bins.
    """
    n = base_outputs.shape[0]
    continuous = length_features[:, :2]
    bins = length_features[:, 2:]

    interactions_cont = np.hstack(
        [base_outputs * continuous[:, [j]] for j in range(continuous.shape[1])]
    )

    interactions_bins = np.hstack(
        [base_outputs * bins[:, [j]] for j in range(bins.shape[1])]
    )

    return np.hstack(
        [
            base_outputs,
            length_features,
            interactions_cont,
            interactions_bins,
        ]
    ).reshape(n, -1)


def train_base_outputs(models, matrices_train, fit_idx, pred_idx, y_global):
    fitted = []

    for model, matrix in zip(models, matrices_train):
        model.fit(matrix[fit_idx], y_global[fit_idx])
        fitted.append(model)

    outputs = [
        aligned_decision(fitted[0], matrices_train[0][pred_idx]),
        aligned_decision(fitted[1], matrices_train[1][pred_idx]),
        aligned_decision(fitted[2], matrices_train[2][pred_idx]),
        aligned_log_probability(fitted[3], matrices_train[3][pred_idx]),
    ]

    return np.hstack(outputs), fitted


def fit_calibrator(x_train, y_train, c_value):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    x_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(x_train)

    model = LogisticRegression(
        C=c_value,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1200,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    model.fit(x_scaled, y_train)

    return scaler, model


def calibrated_predict(scaler, model, x):
    pred = model.predict_proba(scaler.transform(x))

    # Match the competition's safe probability range.
    pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
    pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    return pred


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    n_train = len(train_text)

    y_global = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y_global < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label encountered.")

    # Transductive, label-free vectorizer fitting on train and test text.
    vectorizers = build_vectorizers()
    all_matrices = [vectorizer.fit_transform(all_text) for vectorizer in vectorizers]

    train_matrices = [matrix[:n_train] for matrix in all_matrices]
    test_matrices = [matrix[n_train:] for matrix in all_matrices]

    # Important fix:
    # derive length scaling only from training data and reuse it for test data.
    length_mean, length_std = fit_length_statistics(train_text)

    length_train = make_length_features(
        train_text,
        mean=length_mean,
        std=length_std,
    )
    length_test = make_length_features(
        test_text,
        mean=length_mean,
        std=length_std,
    )

    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # Four base models x three class outputs.
    oof_base = np.zeros((n_train, 12), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (fit_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(
        outer_cv.split(train_text, y_global),
        start=1,
    ):
        print(f"outer fold {fold}/5")

        models = make_base_models()

        valid_outputs, _ = train_base_outputs(
            models=models,
            matrices_train=train_matrices,
            fit_idx=fit_idx,
            pred_idx=valid_idx,
            y_global=y_global,
        )

        oof_base[valid_idx] = valid_outputs

    oof_meta = make_meta_features(oof_base, length_train)

    # Select calibrator regularization using a separate CV over OOF rows.
    meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 17,
    )

    candidate_c = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in candidate_c:
        fold_losses = []

        for meta_fit_idx, meta_valid_idx in meta_cv.split(
            oof_meta,
            y_global,
        ):
            scaler, calibrator = fit_calibrator(
                oof_meta[meta_fit_idx],
                y_global[meta_fit_idx],
                c_value,
            )

            pred = calibrated_predict(
                scaler,
                calibrator,
                oof_meta[meta_valid_idx],
            )

            fold_losses.append(
                log_loss(
                    y_global[meta_valid_idx],
                    pred,
                    labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
                )
            )

        scores[c_value] = float(np.mean(fold_losses))

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)

    print(f"5-fold cross-validation log loss: {scores[best_c]:.6f}")
    print(f"selected length-aware calibrator C: {best_c}")

    # Fit all base models on the complete labeled training set.
    final_models = make_base_models()

    for model, matrix in zip(final_models, train_matrices):
        model.fit(matrix, y_global)

    test_base = np.hstack(
        [
            aligned_decision(final_models[0], test_matrices[0]),
            aligned_decision(final_models[1], test_matrices[1]),
            aligned_decision(final_models[2], test_matrices[2]),
            aligned_log_probability(final_models[3], test_matrices[3]),
        ]
    )

    test_meta = make_meta_features(test_base, length_test)

    # Fit final calibrator only on genuine outer-fold predictions.
    final_scaler, final_calibrator = fit_calibrator(
        oof_meta,
        y_global,
        best_c,
    )

    test_pred = calibrated_predict(
        final_scaler,
        final_calibrator,
        test_meta,
    )

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def boundary_text(text):
    """Preserve normal words while adding sentence-start/end markers."""
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+(?:['’][A-Za-z]+)?", text.lower())
    if not words:
        return "__bos__ __eos__"

    tagged = []
    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if i < 4:
            tagged.append(f"__first{i}__{word}")
        elif i >= len(words) - 4:
            tagged.append(f"__last{len(words)-1-i}__{word}")
        else:
            tagged.append(word)

    return "__bos__ " + " ".join(tagged) + " __eos__"


def aligned_decision(model, x):
    scores = np.asarray(model.decision_function(x))
    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]
    return out


def aligned_log_proba(model, x):
    raw = np.asarray(model.predict_log_proba(x))
    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    return out


def build_vectorizers():
    return [
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(3, 6),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=200000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            min_df=1,
            max_features=180000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            token_pattern=r"(?u)\b[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_’']*\b",
            lowercase=False,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
        CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            binary=True,
            min_df=1,
            max_features=180000,
            strip_accents="unicode",
            lowercase=True,
            dtype=np.float32,
        ),
    ]


def make_models():
    return [
        LinearSVC(C=1.4, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.0, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=1.2, random_state=SEED),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.20),
    ]


def make_meta(models, matrices):
    return np.hstack(
        [
            aligned_decision(models[0], matrices[0]),
            aligned_decision(models[1], matrices[1]),
            aligned_decision(models[2], matrices[2]),
            aligned_log_proba(models[3], matrices[3]),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float64)


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    n_train = len(train_text)

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes.astype(np.int64)

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])
    all_boundary_text = np.array([boundary_text(x) for x in all_text], dtype=object)

    vectorizers = build_vectorizers()

    # All vectorizers are unsupervised and fitted transductively.
    ordinary_word = vectorizers[0].fit_transform(all_text)
    char_wb = vectorizers[1].fit_transform(all_text)
    position_word = vectorizers[2].fit_transform(all_boundary_text)
    binary_word = vectorizers[3].fit_transform(all_text)

    matrices_all = [
        ordinary_word,
        char_wb,
        position_word,
        binary_word,
    ]

    matrices_train = [x[:n_train] for x in matrices_all]
    matrices_test = [x[n_train:] for x in matrices_all]

    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, N_CLASSES * 4), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(outer_cv.split(matrices_train[0], y), 1):
        models = make_models()

        for model, matrix in zip(models, matrices_train):
            model.fit(matrix[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])

        valid_matrices = [matrix[va_idx] for matrix in matrices_train]
        oof_meta[va_idx] = make_meta(models, valid_matrices)

        print(f"outer fold {fold}/5 complete")

    # Select the stacker using a separate five-fold validation over OOF features.
    meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 17,
    )

    candidate_c = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in candidate_c:
        heldout_pred = np.zeros((n_train, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

        for meta_tr, meta_va in meta_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            x_tr = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta[meta_tr])
            x_va = scaler.transform(oof_meta[meta_va])

            stacker = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=1000,
                random_state=SEED,
            )
            stacker.fit(x_tr, y[meta_tr])
            heldout_pred[meta_va] = stacker.predict_proba(x_va)

        heldout_pred = np.clip(heldout_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
        heldout_pred /= heldout_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        scores[c_value] = log_loss(
            y,
            heldout_pred,
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)
    print(f"5-fold cross-validation log loss: {scores[best_c]:.6f}")
    print(f"selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    # Fit final base models on all labeled data.
    final_models = make_models()
    for model, matrix in zip(final_models, matrices_train):
        model.fit(matrix, y)

    test_meta = make_meta(final_models, matrices_test)

    # Fit final stacker on all outer-fold OOF predictions.
    final_scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = final_scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)
    test_scaled = final_scaler.transform(test_meta)

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(test_scaled)
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def class_specific_margins(x_train, y_train, x_valid, c_values):
    """
    Train one binary LinearSVC per author versus all other authors.
    The returned columns are always ordered EAP, HPL, MWS.
    """
    scores = np.zeros((x_valid.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for cls in range(N_CLASSES):
        binary_y = (y_train == cls).astype(np.int8)

        model = LinearSVC(
            C=float(c_values[cls]),
            class_weight="balanced",
            max_iter=5000,
            random_state=SEED + cls,
        )
        model.fit(x_train, binary_y)
        scores[:, cls] = model.decision_function(x_valid)

    return scores


def fit_final_class_specific_models(x_train, y_train, c_values):
    models = []
    for cls in range(N_CLASSES):
        binary_y = (y_train == cls).astype(np.int8)
        model = LinearSVC(
            C=float(c_values[cls]),
            class_weight="balanced",
            max_iter=5000,
            random_state=SEED + cls,
        )
        model.fit(x_train, binary_y)
        models.append(model)
    return models


def predict_class_specific_models(models, x):
    scores = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for cls, model in enumerate(models):
        scores[:, cls] = model.decision_function(x)
    return scores


def cnb_log_probabilities(x_train, y_train, x_valid):
    model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.20)
    model.fit(x_train, y_train)

    raw = model.predict_log_proba(x_valid)
    output = np.full((x_valid.shape[0], N_CLASSES), -50.0, dtype=np.float64)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        output[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]

    return output, model


def select_stacker(oof_meta, y):
    """
    Select stacker regularization with a separate five-fold CV over OOF
    meta-features, preventing evaluation on rows used to fit the stacker.
    """
    inner_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 100,
    )

    candidate_cs = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in candidate_cs:
        fold_losses = []

        for inner_train, inner_valid in inner_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            x_inner_train = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta[inner_train])
            x_inner_valid = scaler.transform(oof_meta[inner_valid])

            stacker = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=2000,
                random_state=SEED,
            )
            stacker.fit(x_inner_train, y[inner_train])

            pred = stacker.predict_proba(x_inner_valid)
            pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
            pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

            fold_losses.append(
                log_loss(
                    y[inner_valid],
                    pred,
                    labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
                )
            )

        scores[c_value] = float(np.mean(fold_losses))

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)
    print(f"5-fold cross-validation log loss: {scores[best_c]:.6f}")
    print(f"selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaled_meta = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=2000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(scaled_meta, y)

    return scaler, final_stacker, best_c


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    n_train = len(train_text)
    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    vectorizers = build_vectorizers()
    matrices = [vec.fit_transform(all_text) for vec in vectorizers]

    train_views = [matrix[:n_train] for matrix in matrices]
    test_views = [matrix[n_train:] for matrix in matrices]

    # Author-specific regularization for the three one-vs-rest classifiers.
    # The values are intentionally slightly different to account for
    # author-specific sample size and stylistic separability.
    svc_c_values = [
        np.array([1.35, 0.95, 1.10]),  # word
        np.array([1.05, 0.80, 0.95]),  # character
        np.array([1.00, 0.75, 0.90]),  # char_wb
    ]

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # Three SVC views x three class-specific margins, plus three CNB scores.
    n_meta_features = 4 * N_CLASSES
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, n_meta_features), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(train_text, y), 1):
        print(f"fold {fold}/5")

        fold_features = []

        for view_idx in range(3):
            margins = class_specific_margins(
                train_views[view_idx][tr_idx],
                y[tr_idx],
                train_views[view_idx][va_idx],
                svc_c_values[view_idx],
            )
            fold_features.append(margins)

        cnb_scores, _ = cnb_log_probabilities(
            train_views[3][tr_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
            train_views[3][va_idx],
        )
        fold_features.append(cnb_scores)

        oof_meta[va_idx] = np.hstack(fold_features)

    scaler, stacker, best_c = select_stacker(oof_meta, y)

    # Refit every base model on all labeled data.
    final_svc_models = []
    for view_idx in range(3):
        models = fit_final_class_specific_models(
            train_views[view_idx],
            y,
            svc_c_values[view_idx],
        )
        final_svc_models.append(models)

    final_cnb = ComplementNB(alpha=0.20)
    final_cnb.fit(train_views[3], y)

    # Build test meta-features in exactly the same order as OOF features.
    test_meta_parts = []

    for view_idx in range(3):
        test_scores = predict_class_specific_models(
            final_svc_models[view_idx],
            test_views[view_idx],
        )
        test_meta_parts.append(test_scores)

    test_cnb_logp = final_cnb.predict_log_proba(test_views[3])
    aligned_test_cnb = np.full(
        (len(test), N_CLASSES),
        -50.0,
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    for j, cls in enumerate(final_cnb.classes_):
        aligned_test_cnb[:, int(cls)] = test_cnb_logp[:, j]

    test_meta_parts.append(aligned_test_cnb)
    test_meta = np.hstack(test_meta_parts)

    test_pred = stacker.predict_proba(scaler.transform(test_meta))
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
