import os
import re
import random
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

SEED = 42
DATA_DIR = "./data"
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def seed_everything(seed=SEED):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)


# Common English function words. Keeping these as a separate view gives
# the model access to syntactic/cadence information without content words.
FUNCTION_WORDS = set("""
a an the and or but if then else for nor so yet of in on at by to from with
without into onto upon over under between through during before after above
below as is am are was were be been being do does did have has had having
can could may might must shall should will would ought need dare used
i me my mine myself we us our ours ourselves you your yours yourself
he him his himself she her hers herself it its itself they them their theirs
themselves this that these those who whom whose which what when where why how
all any both each few many more most other some such no not only own same
than too very just even also still already again here there now then
because while although though until unless since once about against among around
per per via either neither ever never always often sometimes usually
""".split())

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]+(?:['’][A-Za-z]+)?", flags=re.UNICODE)


def tokens(text):
    return TOKEN_RE.findall(str(text).lower())


def content_view(text):
    ts = tokens(text)
    return " ".join(t for t in ts if t not in FUNCTION_WORDS)


def function_view(text):
    ts = tokens(text)
    return " ".join(t for t in ts if t in FUNCTION_WORDS)


def make_views(text_array):
    return {
        "word": np.asarray([str(x) for x in text_array]),
        "content": np.asarray([content_view(x) for x in text_array]),
        "function": np.asarray([function_view(x) for x in text_array]),
    }


def aligned_scores(model, x):
    """Return three columns even if a degenerate fold lacks a class."""
    raw = model.decision_function(x)
    if raw.ndim == 1:
        raw = np.column_stack([-raw, raw])
    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    return out


def aligned_logproba(model, x):
    raw = model.predict_log_proba(x)
    out = np.full((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), -np.log(N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    return out


def build_vectorizers(all_views):
    vec = {}

    vec["word"] = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    vec["content"] = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=150000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    vec["function"] = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 4),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=60000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    vec["char"] = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=220000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    vec["count"] = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=180000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    matrices = {}
    for name, vectorizer in vec.items():
        source = all_views["word"] if name in ("char", "count") else all_views[name]
        matrices[name] = vectorizer.fit_transform(source)

    return matrices


def fit_base_models(matrices, y, train_idx, pred_idx):
    result = []

    # Full lexical word model.
    m = LinearSVC(C=1.35, random_state=SEED)
    m.fit(matrices["word"][train_idx], y[train_idx])
    result.append(aligned_scores(m, matrices["word"][pred_idx]))

    # Content-word model.
    m = LinearSVC(C=1.20, random_state=SEED)
    m.fit(matrices["content"][train_idx], y[train_idx])
    result.append(aligned_scores(m, matrices["content"][pred_idx]))

    # Function-word/syntactic model.
    m = LinearSVC(C=0.85, random_state=SEED)
    m.fit(matrices["function"][train_idx], y[train_idx])
    result.append(aligned_scores(m, matrices["function"][pred_idx]))

    # Boundary-aware character model.
    m = LinearSVC(C=1.05, random_state=SEED)
    m.fit(matrices["char"][train_idx], y[train_idx])
    result.append(aligned_scores(m, matrices["char"][pred_idx]))

    # Probabilistic word-frequency model.
    m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.18)
    m.fit(matrices["count"][train_idx], y[train_idx])
    result.append(aligned_logproba(m, matrices["count"][pred_idx]))

    return np.hstack(result).astype(np.float64)


def fit_full_base_models(matrices, y, n_train, n_test):
    train_idx = np.arange(n_train)
    test_idx = np.arange(n_train, n_train + n_test)
    return fit_base_models(matrices, y, train_idx, test_idx)


def main():
    seed_everything()

    train = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv"))
    test = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv"))

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes.astype(np.int64)

    n_train = len(train_text)
    n_test = len(test_text)

    # Unsupervised views use train and test text only; labels are not involved.
    all_views = make_views(all_text)
    matrices = build_vectorizers(all_views)

    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 15), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(outer_cv.split(np.zeros(n_train), y), 1):
        oof_meta[va_idx] = fit_base_models(matrices, y, tr_idx, va_idx)
        print(f"completed outer fold {fold}/5", flush=True)

    # Leakage-safe evaluation of the stacker on the OOF meta-data.
    inner_cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED + 19)
    candidate_c = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in candidate_c:
        pred = np.zeros((n_train, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

        for meta_tr, meta_va in inner_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            z_tr = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta[meta_tr])
            z_va = scaler.transform(oof_meta[meta_va])

            stacker = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=700,
                random_state=SEED,
            )
            stacker.fit(z_tr, y[meta_tr])
            pred[meta_va] = stacker.predict_proba(z_va)

        scores[c_value] = log_loss(
            y,
            np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0),
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)
    print(f"5-fold cross-validation log loss: {scores[best_c]:.6f}")
    print(f"selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    # Fit final stacker on every leakage-safe OOF row.
    final_scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = final_scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=900,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    # Fit all base learners on the complete labeled training data.
    test_meta = fit_full_base_models(matrices, y, n_train, n_test)

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(final_scaler.transform(test_meta))
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

    print("saved submission.csv", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = len(CLASSES)


def softmax(scores):
    scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float64)
    scores = scores - np.max(scores, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    exp_scores = np.exp(np.clip(scores, -50.0, 50.0))
    return exp_scores / np.maximum(exp_scores.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-15)


def safe_log_loss(y, probabilities):
    probabilities = np.asarray(probabilities, dtype=np.float64)
    probabilities = np.clip(probabilities, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
    probabilities /= probabilities.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return log_loss(y, probabilities, labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES))


def make_vectorizers():
    word_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=140000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    char_wb_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=170000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    # New channel: longer character fragments capturing phrase morphology
    # and repeated author-specific local constructions.
    long_char_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(6, 9),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=220000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    word_binary = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=140000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    return word_tfidf, char_wb_tfidf, long_char_tfidf, word_binary


def fit_base_models(word_x, wb_x, long_char_x, binary_x, y):
    word_model = LinearSVC(C=1.25, random_state=SEED)
    wb_model = LinearSVC(C=1.00, random_state=SEED)
    long_char_model = LinearSVC(C=0.85, random_state=SEED)
    cnb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.20)

    word_model.fit(word_x, y)
    wb_model.fit(wb_x, y)
    long_char_model.fit(long_char_x, y)
    cnb_model.fit(binary_x, y)

    return word_model, wb_model, long_char_model, cnb_model


def aligned_decision(model, x):
    raw = model.decision_function(x)
    raw = np.asarray(raw)

    if raw.ndim == 1:
        raw = np.column_stack([-raw, raw])

    output = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        output[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    return output


def base_meta_features(models, word_x, wb_x, long_char_x, binary_x):
    word_model, wb_model, long_char_model, cnb_model = models

    word_scores = aligned_decision(word_model, word_x)
    wb_scores = aligned_decision(wb_model, wb_x)
    long_char_scores = aligned_decision(long_char_model, long_char_x)

    cnb_log_probs = np.full(
        (binary_x.shape[0], N_CLASSES),
        -np.log(N_CLASSES),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    cnb_log_probs[:, cnb_model.classes_] = cnb_model.predict_log_proba(binary_x)

    # Margins preserve confidence and class ordering. CNB log probabilities
    # provide a probabilistic lexical view with a different inductive bias.
    return np.hstack(
        [
            word_scores,
            wb_scores,
            long_char_scores,
            cnb_log_probs,
        ]
    ).astype(np.float64)


def select_stacker(oof_meta, y):
    """
    Separate five-fold validation over already leakage-safe OOF features.
    This avoids selecting C by evaluating a stacker on the same rows used
    to fit it.
    """
    meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 17,
    )

    candidates = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in candidates:
        fold_losses = []

        for train_idx, valid_idx in meta_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            x_train = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta[train_idx])
            x_valid = scaler.transform(oof_meta[valid_idx])

            stacker = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=1000,
                random_state=SEED,
            )
            stacker.fit(x_train, y[train_idx])
            valid_pred = stacker.predict_proba(x_valid)
            fold_losses.append(safe_log_loss(y[valid_idx], valid_pred))

        scores[c_value] = float(np.mean(fold_losses))

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)

    final_scaler = StandardScaler()
    final_x = final_scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(final_x, y)

    return final_scaler, final_stacker, best_c, scores[best_c]


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    word_vec, wb_vec, long_char_vec, binary_vec = make_vectorizers()

    # These are unsupervised transductive representations: test text is used
    # only to establish vocabulary and IDF statistics, never as labels.
    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    wb_all = wb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    long_char_all = long_char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    binary_all = binary_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    n_train = len(train_text)

    word_train, word_test = word_all[:n_train], word_all[n_train:]
    wb_train, wb_test = wb_all[:n_train], wb_all[n_train:]
    long_char_train, long_char_test = (
        long_char_all[:n_train],
        long_char_all[n_train:],
    )
    binary_train, binary_test = binary_all[:n_train], binary_all[n_train:]

    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # Four base models, each producing three outputs.
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 4 * N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (fit_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(
        outer_cv.split(word_train, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        models = fit_base_models(
            word_train[fit_idx],
            wb_train[fit_idx],
            long_char_train[fit_idx],
            binary_train[fit_idx],
            y[fit_idx],
        )

        oof_meta[valid_idx] = base_meta_features(
            models,
            word_train[valid_idx],
            wb_train[valid_idx],
            long_char_train[valid_idx],
            binary_train[valid_idx],
        )

    scaler, stacker, best_c, cv_score = select_stacker(oof_meta, y)

    # Refit all base learners using every labeled training example.
    final_models = fit_base_models(

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = len(CLASSES)

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
    r"[A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?|\d+|[^\w\s]",
    re.UNICODE,
)

FUNCTION_WORDS = {
    "a",
    "an",
    "the",
    "and",
    "or",
    "but",
    "if",
    "then",
    "than",
    "as",

    "her",
    "hers",
    "it",
    "its",
    "they",
    "them",
    "their",
    "theirs",
    "this",
    "that",
    "these",
    "those",
    "there",
    "here",
    "not",
    "no",
    "nor",
    "very",
    "only",
    "also",
    "so",
    "too",
    "who",
    "whom",
    "whose",
    "which",
    "what",
    "when",
    "where",
    "why",
    "how",
}


def token_shape(tok):
    if tok.isalpha():
        low = tok.lower()

        if low in FUNCTION_WORDS:
            return "FW_" + low

        if tok.isupper() and len(tok) > 1:
            return "CAPS"
        if tok[0].isupper():
            return "TITLE"
        if len(tok) <= 2:
            return "SHORT"
        if len(tok) >= 10:
            return "LONG"

        if low.endswith("ing"):
            return "SUF_ING"
        if low.endswith("ed"):
            return "SUF_ED"
        if low.endswith("ly"):
            return "SUF_LY"
        if low.endswith(("tion", "sion")):
            return "SUF_TION"
        if low.endswith("ness"):
            return "SUF_NESS"
        if low.endswith("ous"):
            return "SUF_OUS"
        if low.endswith("ment"):
            return "SUF_MENT"
        if low.endswith(("er", "est")):
            return "SUF_DEG"

        return "WORD"

    if tok.isdigit():
        return "NUM"

    if tok in {".", "!", "?", ";", ":", ",", "-", "—", "–"}:
        return "P_" + tok

    if tok in {"'", "’", '"', "“", "”", "`"}:
        return "QUOTE"

    if tok in {"(", ")", "[", "]", "{", "}"}:
        return "BRACKET"

    return "P_OTHER"


def skeletonize(text):
    tokens = TOKEN_RE.findall(str(text))
    mapped = ["BOS"]
    mapped.extend(token_shape(tok) for tok in tokens)
    mapped.append("EOS")

    if len(mapped) >= 3:
        mapped[1] = "FIRST_" + mapped[1]
        mapped[-2] = "LAST_" + mapped[-2]

    return " ".join(mapped)


def make_vectorizers():
    # Reduced caps preserve the original feature channels while avoiding
    # excessive vocabulary construction and sparse-model training time.
    word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=90000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=90000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    char_wb_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=90000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    binary_vec = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=90000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    skeleton_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        token_pattern=r"(?u)\S+",
        ngram_range=(1, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=35000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=False,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    return word_vec, char_vec, char_wb_vec, binary_vec, skeleton_vec


def fit_base_models(word_x, char_x, wb_x, binary_x, skeleton_x, y):
    models = [
        LinearSVC(C=1.35, random_state=SEED, max_iter=2500),
        LinearSVC(C=1.00, random_state=SEED, max_iter=2500),
        LinearSVC(C=1.00, random_state=SEED, max_iter=2500),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.20),
        LinearSVC(C=0.80, random_state=SEED, max_iter=2500),
    ]

    models[0].fit(word_x, y)
    models[1].fit(char_x, y)
    models[2].fit(wb_x, y)
    models[3].fit(binary_x, y)
    models[4].fit(skeleton_x, y)

    return models


def base_meta_features(
    models,
    word_x,
    char_x,
    wb_x,
    binary_x,
    skeleton_x,
):
    word_model, char_model, wb_model, cnb_model, skeleton_model = models

    features = np.hstack(
        [
            word_model.decision_function(word_x),
            char_model.decision_function(char_x),
            wb_model.decision_function(wb_x),
            cnb_model.predict_log_proba(binary_x),
            skeleton_model.decision_function(skeleton_x),
        ]
    )

    return np.asarray(features, dtype=np.float64)


def fit_and_score_stacker(oof_meta, y):
    """
    Select the stacker regularization using a separate five-fold validation
    over the already leakage-safe out-of-fold base-model predictions.
    """
    inner_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 101,
    )

    # A compact grid substantially reduces runtime while retaining
    # under-, medium-, and over-regularized choices.
    candidates = [0.1, 1.0, 10.0]
    scores = {}

    for c_value in candidates:
        pred = np.zeros((len(y), N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

        for tr_idx, va_idx in inner_cv.split(oof_meta, y):
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            xtr = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta[tr_idx])
            xva = scaler.transform(oof_meta[va_idx])

            model = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=1000,
                random_state=SEED,
            )
            model.fit(xtr, y[tr_idx])
            pred[va_idx] = model.predict_proba(xva)

        pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
        pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

        scores[c_value] = log_loss(
            y,
            pred,
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

    best_c = min(scores, key=scores.get)

    final_scaler = StandardScaler()
    final_x = final_scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(final_x, y)

    return final_scaler, final_stacker, best_c, scores[best_c]


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes.astype(np.int64)

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    print(f"Training rows: {len(train_text)}")
    print(f"Test rows: {len(test_text)}")

    print("Building syntactic skeletons...")
    all_skeleton = np.array(
        [skeletonize(text) for text in all_text],
        dtype=object,
    )

    print("Fitting vectorizers...")
    word_vec, char_vec, wb_vec, binary_vec, skeleton_vec = make_vectorizers()

    # Label-free transductive vocabulary and IDF construction.
    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    wb_all = wb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    binary_all = binary_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    skeleton_all = skeleton_vec.fit_transform(all_skeleton)

    n_train = len(train_text)

    word_train, word_test = word_all[:n_train], word_all[n_train:]
    char_train, char_test = char_all[:n_train], char_all[n_train:]
    wb_train, wb_test = wb_all[:n_train], wb_all[n_train:]
    binary_train, binary_test = binary_all[:n_train], binary_all[n_train:]
    skeleton_train, skeleton_test = (
        skeleton_all[:n_train],
        skeleton_all[n_train:],
    )

    print(
        "Feature dimensions:",
        word_train.shape[1],
        char_train.shape[1],
        wb_train.shape[1],
        binary_train.shape[1],
        skeleton_train.shape[1],
    )

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    oof_meta = np.zeros(
        (n_train, 5 * N_CLASSES),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    print("Generating five-fold out-of-fold base predictions...")
    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(word_train, y), start=1):
        print(f"  Base-model fold {fold}/5")

        models = fit_base_models(
            word_train[tr_idx],
            char_train[tr_idx],
            wb_train[tr_idx],
            binary_train[tr_idx],
            skeleton_train[tr_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
        )

        oof_meta[va_idx] = base_meta_features(
            models,
            word_train[va_idx],
            char_train[va_idx],
            wb_train[va_idx],
            binary_train[va_idx],
            skeleton_train[va_idx],
        )

    scaler, stacker, best_c, cv_score = fit_and_score_stacker(
        oof_meta,
        y,
    )

    print(f"5-fold validation log loss: {cv_score:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    print("Fitting final base models on all training data...")
    final_models = fit_base_models(
        word_train,
        char_train,
        wb_train,
        binary_train,
        skeleton_train,
        y,
    )

    print("Predicting test data...")
    test_meta = base_meta_features(
        final_models,
        word_test,
        char_test,
        wb_test,
        binary_test,
        skeleton_test,
    )

    test_pred = stacker.predict_proba(scaler.transform(test_meta))
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        test_pred,
        columns=CLASSES,
    )
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Saved ./submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, SplineTransformer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3


def make_vectorizers():
    word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=140000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=170000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    char_wb_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=170000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    binary_word_vec = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=140000,
        binary=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    return word_vec, char_vec, char_wb_vec, binary_word_vec


def aligned_decision(model, matrix):
    scores = model.decision_function(matrix)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    output = np.zeros((matrix.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        output[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    return output


def fit_base_models(word_x, char_x, wb_x, binary_x, y):
    word_model = LinearSVC(
        C=1.35,
        class_weight=None,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    char_model = LinearSVC(
        C=1.00,
        class_weight=None,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    wb_model = LinearSVC(
        C=1.00,
        class_weight=None,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    cnb_model = ComplementNB(alpha=0.20)

    word_model.fit(word_x, y)
    char_model.fit(char_x, y)
    wb_model.fit(wb_x, y)
    cnb_model.fit(binary_x, y)

    return word_model, char_model, wb_model, cnb_model


def base_meta_features(models, word_x, char_x, wb_x, binary_x):
    word_model, char_model, wb_model, cnb_model = models

    word_scores = aligned_decision(word_model, word_x)
    char_scores = aligned_decision(char_model, char_x)
    wb_scores = aligned_decision(wb_model, wb_x)
    cnb_scores = cnb_model.predict_log_proba(binary_x).astype(np.float64)

    return np.hstack([word_scores, char_scores, wb_scores, cnb_scores]).astype(
        np.float64
    )


def build_spline_features(x, n_knots=6):
    spline = SplineTransformer(
        n_knots=n_knots,
        degree=3,
        knots="quantile",
        include_bias=False,
    )
    transformed = spline.fit_transform(x)
    return spline, transformed


def fit_spline_stacker(x_train, y_train, c_value, n_knots=6):
    spline, x_spline = build_spline_features(x_train, n_knots=n_knots)

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    x_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(x_spline)

    model = LogisticRegression(
        C=c_value,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1200,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    model.fit(x_scaled, y_train)

    return spline, scaler, model


def predict_spline_stacker(bundle, x):
    spline, scaler, model = bundle
    x_spline = spline.transform(x)
    x_scaled = scaler.transform(x_spline)
    pred = model.predict_proba(x_scaled)
    pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return pred


def nested_stacker_selection(meta_x, y):
    meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 100,
    )

    candidate_c = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]
    candidate_scores = []

    for c_value in candidate_c:
        fold_losses = []

        for tr_idx, va_idx in meta_cv.split(meta_x, y):
            bundle = fit_spline_stacker(
                meta_x[tr_idx],
                y[tr_idx],
                c_value=c_value,
                n_knots=6,
            )

            pred = predict_spline_stacker(bundle, meta_x[va_idx])
            fold_losses.append(
                log_loss(
                    y[va_idx],
                    pred,
                    labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
                )
            )

        candidate_scores.append(float(np.mean(fold_losses)))

    best_index = int(np.argmin(candidate_scores))
    best_c = candidate_c[best_index]
    best_score = candidate_scores[best_index]

    return best_c, best_score


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected author label found.")

    word_vec, char_vec, wb_vec, binary_vec = make_vectorizers()

    # Unsupervised transductive feature construction.
    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    wb_all = wb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    binary_all = binary_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    n_train = len(train_text)

    word_train = word_all[:n_train]
    word_test = word_all[n_train:]

    char_train = char_all[:n_train]
    char_test = char_all[n_train:]

    wb_train = wb_all[:n_train]
    wb_test = wb_all[n_train:]

    binary_train = binary_all[:n_train]
    binary_test = binary_all[n_train:]

    outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    # Four models x three class outputs.
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 12), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(
        outer_cv.split(word_train, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        models = fit_base_models(
            word_train[tr_idx],
            char_train[tr_idx],
            wb_train[tr_idx],
            binary_train[tr_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
        )

        oof_meta[va_idx] = base_meta_features(
            models,
            word_train[va_idx],
            char_train[va_idx],
            wb_train[va_idx],
            binary_train[va_idx],
        )

    best_c, cv_score = nested_stacker_selection(oof_meta, y)

    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {cv_score:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected spline stacker C: {best_c}")

    final_models = fit_base_models(
        word_train,
        char_train,
        wb_train,
        binary_train,
        y,
    )

    test_meta = base_meta_features(
        final_models,
        word_test,
        char_test,
        wb_test,
        binary_test,
    )

    final_bundle = fit_spline_stacker(
        oof_meta,
        y,
        c_value=best_c,
        n_knots=6,
    )

    test_pred = predict_spline_stacker(final_bundle, test_meta)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        test_pred,
        columns=CLASSES,
    )
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ============================================================
# Configuration
# ============================================================
DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42

CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = len(CLASSES)

# Runtime-safe settings retaining the original methodology.
MAX_VOCAB = 12000
MAX_LEN = 64
EMBED_DIM = 32
HIDDEN_DIM = 32
BATCH_SIZE = 1024
GRU_EPOCHS = 1
GRU_LR = 2e-3
GRU_WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4

N_FOLDS = 5

DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


# ============================================================
# Reproducibility
# ============================================================
def seed_everything(seed=SEED):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)

    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
        torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = False
        torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True


seed_everything()


# ============================================================
# Text sequence preparation
# ============================================================
TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?|[0-9]+|[^A-Za-z0-9\s]")


def tokenize(text):
    return TOKEN_RE.findall(text.lower())


def build_vocab(texts, max_vocab=MAX_VOCAB):
    counter = Counter()

    for text in texts:
        counter.update(tokenize(text))

    # Index 0 is padding and index 1 is unknown.
    vocab = {"<PAD>": 0, "<UNK>": 1}

    for token, _ in counter.most_common(max_vocab - 2):
        vocab[token] = len(vocab)

    return vocab


def encode_texts(texts, vocab, max_len=MAX_LEN):
    encoded = np.zeros((len(texts), max_len), dtype=np.int64)

    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        tokens = tokenize(text)[:max_len]
        ids = [vocab.get(token, 1) for token in tokens]

        if ids:
            encoded[i, : len(ids)] = ids

    return encoded


# ============================================================
# Sparse models
# ============================================================
def make_word_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=1,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=60000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_wb_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=60000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_word_counts():
    return CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=70000,
        lowercase=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        binary=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def aligned_decision(model, x):
    scores = model.decision_function(x)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    result = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        result[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    return result


def aligned_logprob(model, x):
    scores = model.predict_log_proba(x)
    result = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        result[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    return result


# ============================================================
# BiGRU model
# ============================================================
class BiGRUClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size):
        super().__init__()

        # vocab_size is the complete shared train/test vocabulary size.
        # This prevents validation/test token IDs from exceeding the
        # embedding table in a particular fold.
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(
            num_embeddings=vocab_size,
            embedding_dim=EMBED_DIM,
            padding_idx=0,
        )

        self.gru = nn.GRU(
            input_size=EMBED_DIM,
            hidden_size=HIDDEN_DIM,
            batch_first=True,
            bidirectional=True,
        )

        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.35)
        self.head = nn.Linear(2 * HIDDEN_DIM, N_CLASSES)

    def forward(self, x):
        mask = x.ne(0)
        lengths = mask.sum(dim=1).clamp_min(1).cpu()

        embedded = self.embedding(x)

        packed = pack_padded_sequence(
            embedded,
            lengths,
            batch_first=True,
            enforce_sorted=False,
        )

        _, hidden = self.gru(packed)

        # For a bidirectional GRU:
        # hidden[-2] is the final forward state,
        # hidden[-1] is the final backward state.
        pooled = torch.cat([hidden[-2], hidden[-1]], dim=1)
        pooled = self.dropout(pooled)

        return self.head(pooled)


def train_gru(
    x_train,
    y_train,
    x_pred,
    vocab_size,
    seed_offset=0,
):
    seed_everything(SEED + seed_offset)

    model = BiGRUClassifier(vocab_size).to(DEVICE)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        model.parameters(),
        lr=GRU_LR,
        weight_decay=GRU_WEIGHT_DECAY,
    )

    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(x_train),
        torch.from_numpy(y_train.astype(np.int64)),
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=0,
        pin_memory=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"),
    )

    model.train()

    for epoch in range(GRU_EPOCHS):
        running_loss = 0.0
        seen = 0

        for xb, yb in train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)

            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

            logits = model(xb)
            loss = criterion(logits, yb)

            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

            running_loss += float(loss.item()) * len(yb)
            seen += len(yb)

        print(
            f"    GRU epoch {epoch + 1}/{GRU_EPOCHS} "
            f"loss={running_loss / max(seen, 1):.5f}",
            flush=True,
        )

    model.eval()

    pred_dataset = TensorDataset(torch.from_numpy(x_pred))
    pred_loader = DataLoader(
        pred_dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=0,
        pin_memory=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"),
    )

    predictions = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for (xb,) in pred_loader:
            xb = xb.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            predictions.append(model(xb).cpu().numpy())

    del model
    del optimizer
    del train_loader
    del pred_loader

    if DEVICE.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return np.vstack(predictions).astype(np.float64)


# ============================================================
# Fold training and prediction
# ============================================================
def fold_predictions(
    word_all,
    char_all,
    count_all,
    sequence_all,
    vocab_size,
    tr_idx,
    va_idx,
    y,
    fold_number,
):
    word_svc = LinearSVC(
        C=2.5,
        max_iter=1500,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    char_svc = LinearSVC(
        C=2.5,
        max_iter=1500,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    cnb = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    print("  Fitting word LinearSVC...", flush=True)
    word_svc.fit(word_all[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])

    print("  Fitting character LinearSVC...", flush=True)
    char_svc.fit(char_all[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])

    print("  Fitting ComplementNB...", flush=True)
    cnb.fit(count_all[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])

    word_scores = aligned_decision(word_svc, word_all[va_idx])
    char_scores = aligned_decision(char_svc, char_all[va_idx])
    count_scores = aligned_logprob(cnb, count_all[va_idx])

    print("  Fitting BiGRU...", flush=True)
    gru_scores = train_gru(
        x_train=sequence_all[tr_idx],
        y_train=y[tr_idx],
        x_pred=sequence_all[va_idx],
        vocab_size=vocab_size,
        seed_offset=fold_number,
    )

    return np.hstack(
        [
            word_scores,
            char_scores,
            count_scores,
            gru_scores,
        ]
    )


def fit_final_models(
    word_all,
    char_all,
    count_all,
    sequence_all,
    vocab_size,
    n_train,
    y,
):
    train_idx = np.arange(n_train)
    test_idx = np.arange(n_train, word_all.shape[0])

    word_svc = LinearSVC(
        C=2.5,
        max_iter=1500,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    char_svc = LinearSVC(
        C=2.5,
        max_iter=1500,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    cnb = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    print("  Fitting final word LinearSVC...", flush=True)
    word_svc.fit(word_all[train_idx], y)

    print("  Fitting final character LinearSVC...", flush=True)
    char_svc.fit(char_all[train_idx], y)

    print("  Fitting final ComplementNB...", flush=True)
    cnb.fit(count_all[train_idx], y)

    word_scores = aligned_decision(word_svc, word_all[test_idx])
    char_scores = aligned_decision(char_svc, char_all[test_idx])
    count_scores = aligned_logprob(cnb, count_all[test_idx])

    print("  Fitting final BiGRU...", flush=True)
    gru_scores = train_gru(
        x_train=sequence_all[train_idx],
        y_train=y,
        x_pred=sequence_all[test_idx],
        vocab_size=vocab_size,
        seed_offset=100,
    )

    return np.hstack(
        [
            word_scores,
            char_scores,
            count_scores,
            gru_scores,
        ]
    )


# ============================================================
# Main pipeline
# ============================================================
def main():
    train_path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv")
    test_path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv")

    train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test = pd.read_csv(test_path)

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes.astype(np.int64)

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected target class found.")

    print(f"Using device: {DEVICE}", flush=True)
    print(
        f"Train rows: {len(train)}; test rows: {len(test)}",
        flush=True,
    )

    # These representations are fitted once on train + test text.
    # Labels are never used during vectorizer fitting.
    print("\nFitting word TF-IDF...", flush=True)
    word_vec = make_word_tfidf()
    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    print(f"Word feature matrix: {word_all.shape}", flush=True)

    print("\nFitting character TF-IDF...", flush=True)
    char_vec = make_char_wb_tfidf()
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    print(f"Character feature matrix: {char_all.shape}", flush=True)

    print("\nFitting binary word counts...", flush=True)
    count_vec = make_word_counts()
    count_all = count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    print(f"Count feature matrix: {count_all.shape}", flush=True)

    print("\nBuilding shared GRU vocabulary...", flush=True)
    vocab = build_vocab(all_text, MAX_VOCAB)
    sequence_all = encode_texts(all_text, vocab, MAX_LEN)

    # Critical fix: use the entire shared vocabulary size for every fold.
    vocab_size = len(vocab)

    print(
        f"GRU vocabulary size: {vocab_size}; " f"sequence shape: {sequence_all.shape}",
        flush=True,
    )

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=N_FOLDS,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    n_meta = 4 * N_CLASSES
    oof_meta = np.zeros(
        (len(train), n_meta),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(
        cv.split(train_text, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        print(f"\n========== Fold {fold}/{N_FOLDS} ==========", flush=True)

        oof_meta[va_idx] = fold_predictions(
            word_all=word_all,
            char_all=char_all,
            count_all=count_all,
            sequence_all=sequence_all,
            vocab_size=vocab_size,
            tr_idx=tr_idx,
            va_idx=va_idx,
            y=y,
            fold_number=fold,
        )

        fold_pred = oof_meta[va_idx]
        print(
            f"  Fold {fold} completed; " f"meta shape={fold_pred.shape}",
            flush=True,
        )

    # Train the stacker using leakage-safe OOF predictions.
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    best_c = None
    best_loss = np.inf

    for c_value in [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0]:
        stacker = LogisticRegression(
            C=c_value,
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=1000,
            random_state=SEED,
        )

        stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)
        oof_pred = stacker.predict_proba(oof_scaled)

        score = log_loss(
            y,
            np.clip(oof_pred, 1e-15, 1.0),
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

        print(
            f"Stacker C={c_value}: OOF log loss={score:.6f}",
            flush=True,
        )

        if score < best_loss:
            best_loss = score
            best_c = c_value

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    print(
        f"\n5-fold cross-validation log loss: {best_loss:.6f}",
        flush=True,
    )
    print(f"Selected stacker C: {best_c}", flush=True)

    print("\nFitting final models on all training data...", flush=True)

    test_meta = fit_final_models(
        word_all=word_all,
        char_all=char_all,
        count_all=count_all,
        sequence_all=sequence_all,
        vocab_size=vocab_size,
        n_train=len(train),
        y=y,
    )

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(scaler.transform(test_meta))

    # Numerical safety and explicit row normalization.
    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        test_pred,
        columns=CLASSES,
    )
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())

    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(
        f"\nSaved ./submission.csv with "
        f"{len(submission)} rows and columns "
        f"{list(submission.columns)}",
        flush=True,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.isotonic import IsotonicRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = 3
EPS = 1e-6


def make_word_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=1,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_wb_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=180000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_word_counts():
    return CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=200000,
        lowercase=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        binary=False,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def svc_probabilities(model, x):
    scores = model.decision_function(x)
    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    # Align model classes into the fixed EAP/HPL/MWS order.
    aligned = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        aligned[:, int(cls)] = scores[:, j]

    # Softmax conversion; isotonic calibration will correct the scale later.
    aligned -= aligned.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    out = np.exp(np.clip(aligned, -50, 50))
    out /= out.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return np.clip(out, EPS, 1.0)


def cnb_probabilities(model, x):
    out = np.full((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), EPS, dtype=np.float64)
    raw = model.predict_proba(x)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, int(cls)] = raw[:, j]
    out = np.clip(out, EPS, 1.0)
    out /= out.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return out


def fit_calibrators(probabilities, y, train_idx):
    """
    Fit one isotonic calibrator per base model and target class.
    Each calibrator maps a model's probability for class c to the
    empirical probability of that class.
    """
    n_models = probabilities.shape[1]
    calibrators = [[None for _ in range(N_CLASSES)] for _ in range(n_models)]

    for m in range(n_models):
        for c in range(N_CLASSES):
            target = (y[train_idx] == c).astype(np.float64)
            values = probabilities[train_idx, m, c]

            # Isotonic regression is well-defined even when a class has
            # very few observations, but constant fallback is safer.
            if np.unique(values).size < 2 or np.unique(target).size < 2:
                constant = float(np.mean(target))
                calibrators[m][c] = constant
            else:
                calibrators[m][c] = IsotonicRegression(
                    y_min=EPS,
                    y_max=1.0,
                    out_of_bounds="clip",
                ).fit(values, target)

    return calibrators


def apply_calibrators(probabilities, calibrators):
    n_rows, n_models, _ = probabilities.shape
    calibrated = np.zeros_like(probabilities, dtype=np.float64)

    for m in range(n_models):
        for c in range(N_CLASSES):
            cal = calibrators[m][c]
            if isinstance(cal, (float, np.floating)):
                calibrated[:, m, c] = cal
            else:
                calibrated[:, m, c] = cal.predict(probabilities[:, m, c])

    calibrated = np.clip(calibrated, EPS, 1.0)
    calibrated /= calibrated.sum(axis=2, keepdims=True)
    return calibrated


def random_simplex_weights(n_models, n_samples=300, seed=SEED):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    candidates = [np.ones(n_models, dtype=np.float64) / n_models]
    candidates.extend(rng.dirichlet(np.ones(n_models) * 1.2, size=n_samples))
    return np.asarray(candidates)


def blend_predictions(calibrated, weights):
    pred = np.tensordot(calibrated, weights, axes=([1], [0]))
    pred = np.clip(pred, EPS, 1.0)
    pred /= pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return pred


def fit_base_models(features, train_idx, y):
    word_x, char_x, wb_x, count_x = features

    models = [
        LinearSVC(C=2.5, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=2.5, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED),
        LinearSVC(C=2.5, max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED),
        ComplementNB(alpha=0.08),
    ]

    models[0].fit(word_x[train_idx], y[train_idx])
    models[1].fit(char_x[train_idx], y[train_idx])
    models[2].fit(wb_x[train_idx], y[train_idx])
    models[3].fit(count_x[train_idx], y[train_idx])
    return models


def predict_base_models(models, features, row_idx):
    word_x, char_x, wb_x, count_x = features

    outputs = [
        svc_probabilities(models[0], word_x[row_idx]),
        svc_probabilities(models[1], char_x[row_idx]),
        svc_probabilities(models[2], wb_x[row_idx]),
        cnb_probabilities(models[3], count_x[row_idx]),
    ]
    return np.stack(outputs, axis=1)


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(train["author"], categories=CLASSES).codes
    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected target class encountered.")

    n_train = len(train)
    n_total = n_train + len(test)

    # These transformations are unsupervised and are safely fitted
    # transductively on train plus test text.
    word_vec = make_word_tfidf()
    char_vec = make_char_tfidf()
    wb_vec = make_char_wb_tfidf()
    count_vec = make_word_counts()

    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    wb_all = wb_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    count_all = count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    features = (word_all, char_all, wb_all, count_all)

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    n_models = 4
    oof_raw = np.zeros((n_train, n_models, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    print("Generating five-fold out-of-fold predictions...")
    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(train_text, y), 1):
        models = fit_base_models(features, tr_idx, y)
        oof_raw[va_idx] = predict_base_models(models, features, va_idx)
        print(f"Fold {fold}/5 complete")

    # Nested five-fold calibration on the OOF predictions.
    # This produces a held-out estimate for choosing the blend weights.
    meta_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 17,
    )

    nested_pred = np.zeros((n_train, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)

    for inner_tr, inner_va in meta_cv.split(oof_raw, y):
        calibrators = fit_calibrators(oof_raw, y, inner_tr)
        calibrated_va = apply_calibrators(
            oof_raw[inner_va],
            calibrators,
        )

        # Weight selection is performed only using the current
        # meta-training partition's calibrated predictions.
        calibrated_tr = apply_calibrators(
            oof_raw[inner_tr],
            calibrators,
        )

        candidates = random_simplex_weights(
            n_models=n_models,
            n_samples=250,
            seed=SEED + len(inner_va),
        )

        best_weight = candidates[0]
        best_loss = np.inf

        for weights in candidates:
            pred_tr = blend_predictions(calibrated_tr, weights)
            loss = log_loss(
                y[inner_tr],
                pred_tr,
                labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
            )
            if loss < best_loss:
                best_loss = loss
                best_weight = weights

        nested_pred[inner_va] = blend_predictions(
            calibrated_va,
            best_weight,
        )

    nested_score = log_loss(
        y,
        np.clip(nested_pred, EPS, 1.0),
        labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
    )

    # Select the final weight vector using all OOF predictions after
    # fitting calibrators only on the corresponding calibration data.
    full_calibrators = fit_calibrators(
        oof_raw,
        y,
        np.arange(n_train),
    )
    calibrated_oof = apply_calibrators(oof_raw, full_calibrators)

    candidates = random_simplex_weights(
        n_models=n_models,
        n_samples=1000,
        seed=SEED + 999,
    )

    best_weight = candidates[0]
    best_loss = np.inf
    for weights in candidates:
        pred = blend_predictions(calibrated_oof, weights)
        loss = log_loss(y, pred, labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES))
        if loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = loss
            best_weight = weights

    print(f"5-fold cross-validation log loss: {nested_score:.6f}")
    print("Final blend weights:", np.round(best_weight, 4))

    # Fit every base model on all labeled training rows.
    all_train_idx = np.arange(n_train)
    test_idx = np.arange(n_train, n_total)

    final_models = fit_base_models(features, all_train_idx, y)
    test_raw = predict_base_models(final_models, features, test_idx)

    test_calibrated = apply_calibrators(
        test_raw,
        full_calibrators,
    )
    test_pred = blend_predictions(test_calibrated, best_weight)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_pred, columns=CLASSES)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].to_numpy())
    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

DATA_DIR = "./data"
SEED = 42
CLASSES = np.array(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
N_CLASSES = len(CLASSES)


def make_word_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=1,
        max_df=0.995,
        max_features=220000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_char_tfidf():
    return TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(2, 6),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=240000,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_word_counts():
    return CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="word",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=1,
        max_features=220000,
        lowercase=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        binary=True,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


def make_svc():
    return LinearSVC(
        C=2.5,
        max_iter=5000,
        random_state=SEED,
    )


def make_char_logistic():
    # Keep fitting single-process to avoid joblib worker/read-only
    # sparse-array interaction.
    base = LogisticRegression(
        C=1.2,
        solver="liblinear",
        penalty="l2",
        max_iter=1200,
        random_state=SEED,
    )
    return OneVsRestClassifier(base, n_jobs=1)


def writable_csr_slice(matrix, indices):
    """
    Return an independent writable CSR matrix.

    Some scipy/sklearn combinations can produce sparse slices whose
    backing arrays are read-only. LogisticRegression may call sparse
    canonicalization routines that mutate these arrays.
    """
    out = matrix[indices].tocsr(copy=True)

    # Explicitly detach all sparse backing arrays and guarantee writability.
    out.data = np.array(out.data, copy=True)
    out.indices = np.array(out.indices, copy=True)
    out.indptr = np.array(out.indptr, copy=True)

    out.data.flags.writeable = True
    out.indices.flags.writeable = True
    out.indptr.flags.writeable = True

    out.sum_duplicates()
    out.sort_indices()
    return out


def writable_csr_matrix(matrix):
    """Make a complete independent writable CSR copy."""
    out = matrix.tocsr(copy=True)
    out.data = np.array(out.data, copy=True)
    out.indices = np.array(out.indices, copy=True)
    out.indptr = np.array(out.indptr, copy=True)

    out.data.flags.writeable = True
    out.indices.flags.writeable = True
    out.indptr.flags.writeable = True

    out.sum_duplicates()
    out.sort_indices()
    return out


def aligned_decision(model, x):
    scores = model.decision_function(x)

    if scores.ndim == 1:
        scores = np.column_stack([-scores, scores])

    out = np.zeros((x.shape[0], N_CLASSES), dtype=np.float64)
    model_classes = np.asarray(model.classes_, dtype=int)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model_classes):
        out[:, cls] = scores[:, j]

    return out


def aligned_log_probability(model, x):
    probs = model.predict_proba(x)

    out = np.full(
        (x.shape[0], N_CLASSES),
        1e-12,
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    model_classes = np.asarray(model.classes_, dtype=int)

    for j, cls in enumerate(model_classes):
        out[:, cls] = probs[:, j]

    out /= out.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return np.log(np.clip(out, 1e-12, 1.0))


def fit_vectorizers(all_text):
    word_vec = make_word_tfidf()
    char_vec = make_char_tfidf()
    count_vec = make_word_counts()

    word_all = word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_all = char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    count_all = count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    # Keep matrices in a normal CSR representation. Individual model
    # training slices are copied again by writable_csr_slice().
    word_all = writable_csr_matrix(word_all)
    char_all = writable_csr_matrix(char_all)
    count_all = writable_csr_matrix(count_all)

    return word_all, char_all, count_all


def fold_meta_predictions(word_all, char_all, count_all, tr_idx, va_idx, y):
    word_svc = make_svc()
    char_svc = make_svc()
    char_logistic = make_char_logistic()
    word_cnb = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    word_train = writable_csr_slice(word_all, tr_idx)
    char_train = writable_csr_slice(char_all, tr_idx)
    count_train = writable_csr_slice(count_all, tr_idx)

    word_valid = writable_csr_slice(word_all, va_idx)
    char_valid = writable_csr_slice(char_all, va_idx)
    count_valid = writable_csr_slice(count_all, va_idx)

    word_svc.fit(word_train, y[tr_idx])
    char_svc.fit(char_train, y[tr_idx])
    char_logistic.fit(char_train, y[tr_idx])
    word_cnb.fit(count_train, y[tr_idx])

    word_margin = aligned_decision(word_svc, word_valid)
    char_margin = aligned_decision(char_svc, char_valid)
    char_logprob = aligned_log_probability(char_logistic, char_valid)
    cnb_logprob = aligned_log_probability(word_cnb, count_valid)

    return np.hstack(
        [
            word_margin,
            char_margin,
            char_logprob,
            cnb_logprob,
        ]
    )


def fit_final_base_models(word_all, char_all, count_all, n_train, y):
    train_idx = np.arange(n_train)
    test_idx = np.arange(n_train, word_all.shape[0])

    word_svc = make_svc()
    char_svc = make_svc()
    char_logistic = make_char_logistic()
    word_cnb = ComplementNB(alpha=0.08)

    word_train = writable_csr_slice(word_all, train_idx)
    char_train = writable_csr_slice(char_all, train_idx)
    count_train = writable_csr_slice(count_all, train_idx)

    word_test = writable_csr_slice(word_all, test_idx)
    char_test = writable_csr_slice(char_all, test_idx)
    count_test = writable_csr_slice(count_all, test_idx)

    word_svc.fit(word_train, y)
    char_svc.fit(char_train, y)
    char_logistic.fit(char_train, y)
    word_cnb.fit(count_train, y)

    test_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            aligned_decision(word_svc, word_test),
            aligned_decision(char_svc, char_test),
            aligned_log_probability(char_logistic, char_test),
            aligned_log_probability(word_cnb, count_test),
        ]
    )

    return test_meta


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).to_numpy()
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    y = pd.Categorical(
        train["author"],
        categories=CLASSES,
    ).codes

    if np.any(y < 0):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected target class found.")

    print("Fitting vectorizers...")
    word_all, char_all, count_all = fit_vectorizers(all_text)

    cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    meta_width = 4 * N_CLASSES
    oof_meta = np.zeros(
        (len(train), meta_width),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(
        cv.split(train_text, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        print(f"Outer fold {fold}/5")

        oof_meta[va_idx] = fold_meta_predictions(
            word_all,
            char_all,
            count_all,
            tr_idx,
            va_idx,
            y,
        )

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    oof_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(oof_meta)

    inner_cv = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED + 17,
    )

    candidates = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]
    best_c = None
    best_loss = np.inf

    print("Selecting stacker regularization...")

    for c_value in candidates:
        inner_pred = np.zeros(
            (len(y), N_CLASSES),
            dtype=np.float64,
        )

        for inner_tr, inner_va in inner_cv.split(oof_scaled, y):
            stacker = LogisticRegression(
                C=c_value,
                solver="lbfgs",
                max_iter=2500,
                random_state=SEED,
            )

            stacker.fit(
                oof_scaled[inner_tr],
                y[inner_tr],
            )

            inner_pred[inner_va] = stacker.predict_proba(oof_scaled[inner_va])

        score = log_loss(
            y,
            np.clip(inner_pred, 1e-15, 1.0),
            labels=np.arange(N_CLASSES),
        )

        print(f"  C={c_value}: log loss={score:.6f}")

        if score < best_loss:
            best_loss = score
            best_c = c_value

    print(f"5-fold CV log loss: {best_loss:.6f}")
    print(f"Selected stacker C: {best_c}")

    final_stacker = LogisticRegression(
        C=best_c,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=2500,
        random_state=SEED,
    )

    final_stacker.fit(oof_scaled, y)

    print("Fitting final base models...")
    test_meta = fit_final_base_models(
        word_all,
        char_all,
        count_all,
        len(train),
        y,
    )

    test_pred = final_stacker.predict_proba(scaler.transform(test_meta))

    test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_pred /= test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        test_pred,
        columns=CLASSES,
    )
    submission.insert(
        0,
        "id",
        test["id"].to_numpy(),
    )

    submission.to_csv("./submission.csv", index=False)

    print(
        f"Saved ./submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows "
        f"and columns {list(submission.columns)}."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
